events.title: 05 · Diagnoser · Round 1
events.reasoning:
The task: teacher TB failed on PPA power and area budgets. This is post-simulation PPA gate, not a functional/timing bug. Category: the failure is "simulation" stage but checks are PPA synthesis-like. The category options: compile|simulation|timeout|mixed. The stage is simulation, so "simulation" seems right (the PPA checks are reported in the simulation results flow). Hmm — maybe classify as "simulation" since the stage says simulation. The root cause isn't functional; it's implementation cost (area/power) — a synthesis/PPA issue. But the JSON "category" values constrained. Given the failure brief stage is "simulation", choose "simulation". Alternatively "compile"? No — there's no compile error. So "simulation".

Root cause: The design passes functional TB but exceeds power (0.0218 W vs 0.02 W) and area (215820 vs 190000) budgets. Likely causes: large always-on vector rewrites (unconditional register updates each cycle without write-enable), large capacity structures (caches too many lines/sets, checkpoint tables in rename, ROB/IQ entries), wide unused fields. The brief detail explicitly says: "按缺陷清单做等价重构：大向量每拍无条件重写加写使能、ALU 操作数隔离" (large vectors rewritten unconditionally every cycle — add write enables; ALU operand isolation) for power; "降低 checkpoint/表项冗余、砍 cache 行数、去除无消费宽字段" (reduce checkpoint/entry redundancy, cut cache rows, remove wide fields with no consumers) for area.

So the most suspect files: rename_unit.sv (checkpoint table is the largest area contributor — 20924 bytes, also has 2D arrays), icache.sv and dcache.sv (cut cache lines), physical_register_file.sv (register file writes — power), issue_queue.sv (large entries), reorder_buffer.sv (large entries/wide fields), execute_alu.sv (operand isolation). Max 6 entries.

Ordering by suspicion: rename_unit.sv (checkpoint redundancy — explicitly named, plus the saved repair state mentions variable-index writes but that's a synthesis hang, already fixed presumably; now PPA). Actually the current failing check per the repair state is synthesis_gate hang on rename_unit; but the brief now says PPA checks failing. The repair state is background info: TB passes; one synthesizability defect remains in rename_unit (variable-row-index writes). Hmm — but the brief's failing checks are PPA. The repair state says the current failing check is synthesis_gate hang on rename_unit.sv. These conflict? The repair state is "Repair state for the current rv32i5_ooo RTL (TB PASSES; one synthesizability defect remains...)". The teacher TB failure brief is for this round: PPA power and area budget exceeded. Both are relevant: the patch must also keep the synthesis afloat. Should the involved files include rename_unit.sv due to the variable-row write issue? The brief's failing checks are only PPA. But the fix must be behavior-preserving and the patch agent will modify rename_unit for checkpoint area reduction anyway; the repair state tells it also to rewrite variable-index writes. Including rename_unit.sv is essential anyway (biggest area: checkpoint table with 16 slots × 32 bits × 6 fields?).

Which files:
1. rtl/rename_unit.sv — checkpoint/spec map, largest area & activity (speculative map rewrite each cycle), 2D ckpt arrays.
2. rtl/icache.sv — cut cache lines (area) — brief says "砍 cache 行数".
3. rtl/dcache.sv — cut cache rows, store merge logic power.
4. rtl/physical_register_file.sv — register file writes each cycle; write-enable / clock gating for power; also multi-ported read muxes area.
5. rtl/issue_queue.sv — large entries, wide fields, per-cycle vector rewrites (valid masks, ready masks) → power; area of IQ entries.
6. rtl/reorder_buffer.sv — ROB entries wide fields; "去除无消费宽字段" (remove wide fields with no consumer) — ROB stores pc/insn full width for retire debug only at head; could trim.

Alternatively execute_alu.sv for operand isolation (explicitly mentioned in power detail: "ALU 操作数隔离"). Hmm. Power: "大向量每拍无条件重写加写使能、ALU 操作数隔离" — two items: write-enables on large vectors, ALU operand isolation. So execute_alu.sv is directly named. And area: "降低 checkpoint/表项冗余、砍 cache 行数、去除无消费宽字段" — rename (checkpoint), icache/dcache (cache lines), ROB/IQ (wide fields).

Max 6. Candidates: rename_unit, execute_alu, icache, dcache, issue_queue, reorder_buffer, physical_register_file (7). Need to cut one. Which is less likely? PRF — power (write every cycle without enable) is plausible; but PRF is small (4109 bytes). The brief's named levers: checkpoint redundancy (rename), cache lines (icache+dcache), wide fields with no consumers (issue_queue/reorder_buffer/rename), big-vector unconditional rewrites (many modules), ALU operand isolation (execute_alu).

I'd rank: rename_unit.sv (checkpoint table — biggest single area), icache.sv, dcache.sv (cache line cut), issue_queue.sv, reorder_buffer.sv, execute_alu.sv. PRF omitted. Hmm, but PRF's read muxes (4 read ports × 64 entries × 32b) are significant area in synthesis; but 64×32 is ~2KB regs plus muxes — moderate. The IQ at 13440 bytes of RTL is large. Actually issue_queue 13440 bytes, load_store_unit 18741, rename 20924, rv32i5 29905.

Hmm — load_store_unit (18741 bytes) is also big with queues and forwarding muxes. But cache line cut is named. I'll go with the 6 above. Actually, maybe exclude reorder_buffer? The ROB per-entry fields include pc and insn (32+32 bits × 16 entries) which are only needed for the committing head → "去除无消费宽字段" strongly points to ROB/IQ. Keep ROB.

So involved_files order: rename_unit.sv, icache.sv, dcache.sv, execute_alu.sv, issue_queue.sv, reorder_buffer.sv. Hmm — order by suspicion. Power check: unconditional vector rewrites occur in caches (valid/tag arrays), rename (spec_map every cycle), IQ (select masks). Area: caches biggest (tag/data arrays with line count), rename checkpoint. Which to lead with? The repair state emphasize rename is the file with the known issue and largest size. I'll put rename first, then icache, dcache, issue_queue, reorder_buffer, execute_alu.

Actually — ALU operand isolation is explicitly a named defect for power; put execute_alu reasonably high? Power excess is small (0.0218 vs 0.02, 9% over). Area excess is 13.6% over. Both modest. Either fix alone won't suffice; need multiple.

I'll list: rename_unit.sv, icache.sv, dcache.sv, issue_queue.sv, reorder_buffer.sv, execute_alu.sv.

Category: "simulation" — hmm, but the PPA checks usually come from synthesis flow. The allowed categories: compile|simulation|timeout|mixed. Stage is simulation, and there's no compile error. Since the check is a budget gate attached to the simulation stage, "simulation" fits best. But could argue "mixed" as it involves both functional pass + PPA. I'll pick "simulation".

events.title: 06 · Patch · Round 1
events.reasoning:
We need to apply a minimal PPA-reduction patch. The design is functionally passing; only area/power budgets exceeded. We must refactor equivalently.

Key constraints: rename_unit 2D unpacked array writes must use constant row indices with decode loops. The current rename_unit doesn't actually have 2D unpacked arrays — it uses packed vectors. But the constraint hints that the intended rewrite of rename_unit should reduce checkpoint table area (16 slots × 32 spec_map full saves) — but current file already uses a flat spec_map. Hmm.

Let me consider which files to change to get most area reduction with minimal risk.

Areas:
1. icache: line_data [0:3] of 128 bits. Line count is 4. Reducing to 2 lines (one index bit) would reduce area but breaks functionality? The I-cache tag uses cpu_req_addr[31:6], index [5:4]. Reducing lines to 2 and index bit to [4] only would alias addresses. That could break correctness. Better to keep cache size but maybe reduce... Hmm. The instructions explicitly allow "减少 cache 行数" (reduce cache line count). But must preserve TB pass. A direct-mapped 4-line cache with index=addr[5:4] — reducing to 2 lines with index=addr[4] would mean tag=addr[31:5]; functionally still correct (just more misses). That's a valid equivalent refactor: fewer lines, wider tag. Same for dcache. That reduces area but may increase simulation cycles (more refills) — TB likely has cycle budget? It says trace_mismatches empty, failing_suites empty. Risk: longer simulation but should still pass unless timeout. Only 4 lines → 2 lines doubles I-cache miss rate on a tight loop spanning multiple lines? Typically code in TB is small; 2 lines may thrash if the loop covers > 64 bytes (2 lines of 16 bytes each = 32 bytes). Hmm, actually line size is 16 bytes; 4 lines = 64 bytes. Reducing to 2 lines = 32 bytes capacity, likely thrashing on any program loop > 32 bytes. That could dramatically increase runtime and maybe timeout. Risky.

Alternative area reductions that are safe:
- issue_queue: IQ_DEPTH 8 → 4? The ROB depth is 8; issue queue entries 8 with wide fields (pc, insn, pred_next_pc, imm...). Reducing to 4 entries would reduce area significantly with only performance impact. But in-order-ish issue: with depth 4, dispersion stalls more; still functionally correct. But the top-level instantiates issue_queue with parameters? It's a module constant IQ_DEPTH=8; changing to 4 internally is fine as long as indices are 3 bits — sel_idx is [2:0], ent arrays sized by IQ_DEPTH. But loops use IQ_DEPTH; ent_ready etc. sized by IQ_DEPTH. feee_idx 3 bits. If IQ_DEPTH=4, still fine leaving indices 3-bit; entries 4..7 never valid. Actually simpler: change IQ_DEPTH to 4 and keep all indexing logic; loops over 4. free_exist only considers first 4. That works. But issue queue fields: ent_pc [31:0] and ent_insn [31:0] are only used for issue_pc/issue_insn which feed execute_alu's issue_insn (unused!) and issue_pc (used). Does anything consume issue_insn? execute_alu takes issue_insn but never uses it. The TB may not care. But contract requires ports, and internal removal of ent_insn would require issuing constant 0 on issue_insn — the top-level LSU also uses lsu_disp_insn? Let's check: load_store_unit has lsu_disp_insn input; its internals not provided. Can't touch it.

In issue_queue, ent_pc is used as issue_pc (needed for AUIPC and branch PC). ent_insn used only to derive issue_imm_c (immediate) and issue_insn. Wait, issue_imm is computed from sel_insn — the immediate re-decode from instruction bits! But iq_disp_imm is provided as an input and ignored. Interesting: the IQ stores insn and recomputes immediate. We could instead store iq_disp_imm directly (32 bits), and drop ent_insn, and then issue_insn can be driven from... hmm, issue_insn is an output. execute_alu's issue_insn is unused; but the module port must be driven. We could keep ent_insn but that's the wide field. Alternatively store imm and drive issue_insn = something? TB doesn't check issue_insn. But dropping ent_insn while issue_insn output must be something — can drive 32'b0? That changes internal signal but not observable. However "dbg" doesn't expose insn. Risky but maybe fine. Actually packet says "ROB/IQ 表项保留了无消费方的宽字段（pc/insn 等只在提交头使用）" — so removing unused wide fields in IQ/ROB is authorized.

But careful: ROB ent_insn is used for commit_insn → dbg_retire_insn, which the TB checks for trace matching! So ROB's insn is needed. ROB's ent_pc used for commit_pc → dbg_retire_pc, needed. So "无消费方" refers maybe to ROB ent_value? No, needed. Actually in ROB, ent_index [3:0] per entry might be unnecessary if index==slot position, but entries wrap. Hmm.

Let me think about the most reliable area savings with low functional risk:

A) issue_queue: reduce IQ_DEPTH 8→4, remove ent_insn/ent_pc? issue_pc needed for branch target & AUIPC. Keep pc. Remove ent_insn and issue_insn → drive issue_insn = 32'b0? That could affect nothing since execute_alu ignores it. But top-level connects issue_insn to execute_alu only. Yes only u_alu.issue_insn. So safe. But eliminating 8×32 = 256 flops is a big area win, plus muxing. And switch issue_imm to use stored iq_disp_imm instead of decoding from insn: that's also equivalent (id_stage already computed imm). That removes the big case mux. Then ent_insn removed entirely.

Actually wait: `issue_imm_c` decodes from insn; `iq_disp_imm` is passed from rename unit's id_imm. Are they identical? id_stage computes id_imm — yes presumably the same immediate. Should be equivalent. Risk: if id_imm differs (e.g., for JALR etc.), could change behavior. But id_stage's id_imm is used by ALU for other paths. In execute_alu, `op_b = issue_use_imm ? issue_imm : issue_operand2` and branch_target = pc + issue_imm, jal_target = pc + issue_imm. So issue_imm must equal the instruction immediate for branches/jal. If id_stage produces correct imm, fine. The LSU also uses lsu_disp_imm for address computation, so imm is definitely correct.

B) ROB: ent_index [3:0] per entry — used to match completions when indices wrap. The index is 4-bit full pointer; slot is 3 bits. ent_index stores full 4-bit tail at allocation. Matching alu_complete_rob_index (4-bit) against ent_index ensures no aliasing between old instructions. Could we drop ent_index and rely on slot matching only? When an entry is at slot i, its index is either head+i mod 8 increments... Actually index = (head + position) mod 8 when ROB is contiguous from head to tail. Since head and tail are monotonically advancing, index low 3 bits = slot. The full 4-bit index is derivable as head[3] plus offset? Hmm: head increments by 1 each commit; tail = head+count. Index of slot i = (head_base + i) mod 8 where i is position from head. The stored ent_index is the 4-bit pointer at allocation time; low 3 bits equal tail[2:0] at allocation, which equals slot. The 4th bit distinguishes generation parity. alu_complete_rob_index comes from issue entry's rob index (4-bit) captured at alloc. So matching ent_index 4-bit vs 3-bit slot is needed to distinguish a stale completion from previous generation using same slot. But robs are only 8 deep and an instruction completing late after its slot is reused? Flush handling ensures entries before flush cleared, but completion could occur for an entry that was flushed and slot reused: stale alu result would target the same 4-bit index? The 4-bit index also repeats every 16 allocations, so the full index isn't a generation tag either. Risk moderate. Dropping ent_index saves 32 flops (4×8) small.

Better ROB savings: remove ent_is_ctrl? Used for resolve matching only. Needed. ent_index used to gate completions. Could keep.

C) execute_alu operand isolation: gate alu_result computation with issue_valid && issue_ready. Add `if (issue_valid && issue_ready)` around the case, else defaults. This reduces toggling power, small area. Also gate operand `op_b`. This is a "toggling" power reduction. Good for power budget. Must ensure alu_complete_data is don't-care when invalid (it's ignored). But note alu_complete_data is used only when alu_complete_valid. Fine.

D) rename_unit: The current spec_map 192 flops, free_list 96, ready 64, slots 48+48+40. The constraint about 2D arrays perplexing; maybe generated description from original repository. Here spec_map is a packed vector and writes are conditional via next-state and always_ff writes every cycle `spec_map <= spec_map_nxt` unconditionally. Add write-enable: only update spec_map when do_alloc&&need_pr or do_flush. Use per-field writes with enables? To get area savings, we might simplify free-list handling: the free list has 16 entries of 6 bits with complex flush push logic (rank, etc.). This is big combinational area (rank computation with 8×8 comparators). A significant area reduction could come from simplifying the free list management. But risky for correctness.

The packet says root cause: "(1) rename_unit 的 checkpoint 表按 16 个槽 × 32 位 spec_map 全量保存，且大向量每拍无条件重写、无写使能，面积与翻转率双高". Their desired fixes: add write enables, operand isolation, reduce checkpoint/table redundancy, cut cache lines, remove unused wide fields.

Given the current rename already has 8 slots (48 bits) not 16×32. It seems the code has already been through some refactor? "已落地的 FIFO→bitmap 重构不得回退" — FIFO→bitmap refactor already landed. Hmm.

Since the failing check is PPA only, our changes must reduce area by 12% and power by 9%. That's substantial. Need meaningful reductions.

Let's estimate major area:
- Physical register file: 64×32 = 2048 flops ×2 read ports — huge but not in involved list, can't modify.
- IQ: 8 entries × (32 pc + 32 insn + 4 + 6+6+6 + ... + 32 imm decoded? no stored + 32 prednpc) ≈ 8 × 160 bits = 1280 flops. Reducing to 4 entries and removing insn/prednpc? prednpc needed for mispredict resolution? resolve compares resolve_actual != issue_pred_next_pc at top using issue_pred_next_pc from IQ selected entry. Needed. issue_pc needed. So IQ per entry: pc 32, insn 32, rob 4, prs1/2 6+6, pdst 6, r1/2rdy 2, alu_op 5, wb_sel 3, br/jal/jalr/useimm/auipc 5, prednpc 32, predtk 1, predty 2 = 136 bits. 8 entries = 1088 flops.
  - Remove insn (32): -256
  - Depth 8→4: -half = ~400

    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] ST_IDLE   = 2'd0;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_REFILL = 2'd1;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_RESP   = 2'd2;

    logic [1:0]   state;

    logic [127:0] line_data [0:1];
    logic [26:0]  line_tag  [0:1];
    logic [1:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [1:0]  refill_word;

    logic [31:0] resp_data_r;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch_r;

    logic        cpu_idx;
    logic [26:0] cpu_tag;
    logic [1:0]  cpu_wsel;
    logic        cpu_hit;
    logic [31:0] cpu_word;
    logic [127:0] cpu_line;

    assign cpu_idx  = cpu_req_addr[4];
    assign cpu_tag  = cpu_req_addr[31:5];
    assign cpu_wsel = cpu_req_addr[3:2];

    always_comb begin
        cpu_line = line_data[cpu_idx];
        cpu_hit  = line_valid[cpu_idx] && (line_tag[cpu_idx] == cpu_tag);
        case (cpu_wsel)
            2'd0:    cpu_word = cpu_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    cpu_word = cpu_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    cpu_word = cpu_line[95:64];
            default: cpu_word = cpu_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign cpu_req_ready  = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_data  = resp_data_r;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch_r;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_REFILL);
    assign mem_req_addr  = {req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000} + {refill_word, 2'b00};

    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

            state        <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid   <= 2'b00;
            req_addr     <= 32'b0;
            req_epoch    <= 2'b0;
            refill_word  <= 2'b0;
            resp_data_r  <= 32'b0;

                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&

                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign do_flush   = flush && !halted;
    assign alloc_slot = rob_alloc_index;

    assign rd_prd   = need_pr ? free_head_data : PR_ZERO;
    assign old_prd  = need_pr ? spec_old       : PR_ZERO;
    assign pdst_new = need_pr ? rd_prd         : PR_ZERO;

    assign rob_alloc_valid        = do_alloc;
    assign rob_alloc_pc           = id_pc;
    assign rob_alloc_insn         = id_insn;
    assign rob_alloc_pdst         = rd_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_old_prd      = old_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_arch_rd      = id_rd;
    assign rob_alloc_is_control   = is_ctrl;
    assign rob_alloc_is_store     = id_is_store;
    assign rob_alloc_is_ecall     = id_is_ecall;
    assign rob_alloc_reg_write    = need_pr;

    assign iq_disp_valid          = do_alloc && is_alu;
    assign iq_disp_pc             = id_pc;
    assign iq_disp_insn           = id_insn;
    assign iq_disp_rob_index      = rob_alloc_index;
    assign iq_disp_prs1           = rs1_prd;
    assign iq_disp_prs2           = rs2_prd;
    assign iq_disp_pdst           = rd_prd;
    assign iq_disp_rs1_ready      = rs1_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_rs2_ready      = rs2_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_imm            = id_imm;
    assign iq_disp_alu_op         = id_alu_op;
    assign iq_disp_wb_sel         = id_wb_sel;
    assign iq_disp_is_branch      = id_is_branch;
    assign iq_disp_is_jal         = id_is_jal;
    assign iq_disp_is_jalr        = id_is_jalr;
    assign iq_disp_use_imm        = id_use_imm;
    assign iq_disp_is_auipc       = id_is_auipc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_next_pc   = id_pred_next_pc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_taken     = id_pred_taken;
    assign iq_disp_pred_type      = id_pred_type;

    assign lsu_disp_valid         = do_alloc && is_mem;
    assign lsu_disp_pc            = id_pc;
    assign lsu_disp_insn          = id_insn;
    assign lsu_disp_rob_index     = rob_alloc_index;
    assign lsu_disp_prs1          = rs1_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_prs2          = rs2_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_pdst          = rd_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_rs1_ready     = rs1_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_rs2_ready     = rs2_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_imm           = id_imm;
    assign lsu_disp_is_load       = id_is_load;
    assign lsu_disp_is_store      = id_is_store;
    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flush / free-list push helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [3:0]  flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]  flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]  flush_elig;
    logic [23:0] flush_rank;
    logic [31:0] flush_push_pos;
    logic [3:0]  flush_push_count;
    logic        alloc_push_en;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_push_data;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_old;

    assign flush_next4 = flush_rob_index + 4'd1;
    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    // rank[k] = number of eligible slots whose flush distance is smaller
    // than the distance of slot k (constant-index row decode, full drive).
    genvar gk;
    generate
        for (gk = 0; gk < 8; gk = gk + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gk +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_set;
    logic [63:0]  ready_clr;
    logic [7:0]   slot_win;

    assign ready_set = (alu_complete_valid  ? (64'd1 << alu_complete_prd)  : 64'd0) |
                       (load_complete_valid ? (64'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 64'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (64'd1 << rd_prd) : 64'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = do_alloc ? (free_tail + (alloc_push_en ? 4'd1 : 4'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_tail + flush_push_count) :
                                       free_tail;
    assign free_count_nxt = do_alloc ? (free_count + (alloc_push_en ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) - (need_pr ? 5'd1 : 5'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_count + {1'b0, flush_push_count}) :
                                       free_count;

    // Restore winner per checkpoint slot: eligible and no younger eligible
    // slot targets the same architectural register.
    genvar gw;
    generate
        for (gw = 0; gw < 8; gw = gw + 1) begin : gen_slot_win
            assign slot_win[gw] = flush_elig[gw] &&
                !( (flush_elig[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) );
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       rst_hit;
            logic [5:0] rst_val;

            assign rst_hit =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]));

            assign rst_val =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[5:0]   : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[11:6]  : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[17:12] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[23:18] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[29:24] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[35:30] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[41:36] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[47:42] : 6'd0);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga[4:0])) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && rst_hit)                       ? rst_val :
                                                              spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (flush_push_pos[3:0]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[0  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (flush_push_pos[7:4]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[6  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (flush_push_pos[11:8]  == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[12 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (flush_push_pos[15:12] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[18 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (flush_push_pos[19:16] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[24 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (flush_push_pos[23:20] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[30 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (flush_push_pos[27:24] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[36 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (flush_push_pos[31:28] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[42 +: 6] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl[3:0]))             ? alloc_push_data :
                                                                                     free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {64{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (halted) begin
        end else begin
            if (do_alloc || do_flush) begin
                spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
                slot_pdst  <= slot_pdst_nxt;
                slot_old   <= slot_old_nxt;
                slot_rd    <= slot_rd_nxt;
                free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
                free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
                free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            end
            if (do_alloc && need_pr) begin
                free_head <= free_head_nxt;
            end
            if (do_alloc || do_flush || alu_complete_valid || load_complete_valid) begin
                ready_tbl <= ready_nxt;
            end

            if (do_flush) begin
                cur_tail <= flush_next4;
            end else if (do_alloc) begin
                cur_tail <= rob_alloc_index + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/physical_register_file.sv": "module physical_register_file (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] load_complete_data
);

    // The physical-register address is 6 bits wide, so the file must cover
    // all 64 physical registers.  With only 40 entries, writes to allocated
    // physical registers 40..63 were silently dropped and reads returned X.
    // Those X operands propagate into branch/JALR targets and memory
    // addresses, poisoning the predictor BTB and stalling the cache/bus
    // handshakes (the simulation watchdog timeout with no retire mismatches).
    logic [31:0] prf [0:63];

    logic [31:0] iq_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] iq_rdata2_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata2_r;

    integer i;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 64; i = i + 1) begin
                prf[i] <= 32'h0000_0000;
            end
        end else begin
            // Physical register 0 is the architectural x0 and is hardwired.
            prf[0] <= 32'h0000_0000;
            if (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0)) begin
                prf[alu_complete_prd] <= alu_complete_data;
            end
            if (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0)) begin
                prf[load_complete_prd] <= load_complete_data;
            end
        end
    end

    // Write-first (read-during-write) behaviour.  A consumer that is woken by
    // a completion and issues in the same cycle must observe the newly
    // produced value, not the old register-array contents.  Without this the
    // LSU/IQ would compute operands (and memory addresses) from stale data in
    // exactly the cycle the producing ALU/load completes.  The load write
    // port has priority, matching the array write order above.
    always_comb begin
        iq_rdata1_r = (iq_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf[iq_prf_rs1_addr];
        iq_rdata2_r = (iq_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf[iq_prf_rs2_addr];
        lsu_rdata1_r = (lsu_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf[lsu_prf_rs1_addr];
        lsu_rdata2_r = (lsu_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf[lsu_prf_rs2_addr];
    end

    assign iq_prf_rdata1  = iq_rdata1_r;
    assign iq_prf_rdata2  = iq_rdata2_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata1 = lsu_rdata1_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata2 = lsu_rdata2_r;

endmodule

  "rtl/load_store_unit.sv": "module load_store_unit (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_valid,

    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_valid,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_be,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_rob_index,
    output logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_req_epoch,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_req_ready,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_resp_rdata,
    input  logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_resp_epoch,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_wait,
    output logic        lsu_idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_BYTE = 2'b00;
    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_HALF = 2'b01;

    logic        ent_valid     [0:1];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn      [0:1];
    logic [3:0]  ent_rob       [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs1      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs2      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_pdst      [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs1_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs2_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_load   [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_store  [0:1];
    logic [1:0]  ent_epoch     [0:1];
    logic        ent_issued    [0:1];
    logic        ent_committed [0:1];

    logic        req_active;
    logic        req_we_q;
    logic [31:0] req_addr_q;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_be_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob_q;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch_q;

    logic        head_valid;
    logic        tail_valid;
    logic        head_rs1_wake;
    logic        head_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_wake;
    logic        tail_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_ready_eff;
    logic        tail_rs2_ready_eff;
    logic        head_rs1_ok;
    logic        head_rs2_ok;
    logic        head_can_issue;
    logic        head_store_ready;
    logic        head_load_ready;
    logic        head_issue_fire;
    logic        req_accept;
    logic        req_owner_match;
    logic        head_resp_fire;
    logic        head_resp_stale;
    logic        head_load_done;
    logic        head_store_done;
    logic [31:0] head_addr;
    logic [31:0] head_imm;
    logic [3:0]  head_be;
    logic [31:0] head_wdata;
    logic [31:0] load_word;
    logic [31:0] load_data;
    logic [2:0]  head_funct3;
    logic        disp_fire;
    logic        disp_to_head;
    logic        disp_to_tail;
    logic        disp_rs1_eff;
    logic        disp_rs2_eff;
    logic        squash_head;
    logic        squash_tail;
    logic        store_commit_match_head;
    logic        store_commit_match_tail;
    logic        head_remove;
    logic        tail_remove;

    logic        head_rs1_next;
    logic        head_rs2_next;
    logic        tail_rs1_next;
    logic        tail_rs2_next;

    assign head_valid = ent_valid[0];
    assign tail_valid = ent_valid[1];

    assign lsu_prf_rs1_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs1[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs1[1] : 6'd0);
    assign lsu_prf_rs2_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs2[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs2[1] : 6'd0);

    assign head_imm = ent_is_store[0] ?
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:25], ent_insn[0][11:7]} :
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:20]};

    assign head_addr = lsu_prf_rdata1 + head_imm;

    assign head_funct3 = ent_insn[0][14:12];

    always_comb begin
        head_be    = 4'b0000;
        head_wdata = 32'd0;
        case (head_funct3[1:0])
            2'b00: begin
                head_be    = 4'b0001 << head_addr[1:0];
                head_wdata = {4{lsu_prf_rdata2[7:0]}};
            end
            2'b01: begin
                head_be    = head_addr[1] ? 4'b1100 : 4'b0011;
                head_wdata = {2{lsu_prf_rdata2[15:0]}};
            end
            default: begin
                head_be    = 4'b1111;
                head_wdata = lsu_prf_rdata2;
            end
        endcase
    end

    assign head_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0]));
    assign head_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0]));
    assign tail_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1]));
    assign tail_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1]));

    assign tail_rs1_ready_eff = (ent_prs1[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs1_ready[1] || tail_rs1_wake;
    assign tail_rs2_ready_eff = (ent_prs2[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs2_ready[1] || tail_rs2_wake;

    assign head_rs1_ok = (ent_prs1[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs1_ready[0] || head_rs1_wake;
    assign head_rs2_ok = (ent_prs2[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs2_ready[0] || head_rs2_wake;

    assign head_load_ready  = ent_is_load[0] && head_rs1_ok;
    assign head_store_ready = ent_is_store[0] && ent_committed[0] &&
                              head_rs1_ok && head_rs2_ok;

    assign head_can_issue = head_valid && !ent_issued[0] && !halted && !flush &&
                            !req_active && (head_store_ready || head_load_ready);

    assign req_accept = lsu_dcache_req_valid && lsu_dcache_req_ready;
    assign req_owner_match = ent_valid[0] &&
                             (req_rob_q == ent_rob[0]) &&
                             (req_epoch_q == ent_epoch[0]);
    assign head_issue_fire = req_accept &&
                             (req_active ? req_owner_match : 1'b1);

    assign head_resp_fire = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                            lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                            (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch == ent_epoch[0]) &&
                            !squash_head;
    assign head_resp_stale = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                             lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                             (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch != ent_epoch[0]) &&
                             !squash_head;

    assign load_word = lsu_dcache_resp_rdata;

    always_comb begin
        load_data = load_word;
        case (head_funct3)
            3'b000: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {{24{load_word[7]}},  load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {{24{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {{24{load_word[23]}}, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {{24{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b100: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {24'd0, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b001: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            3'b101: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            default: load_data = load_word;
        endcase
    end

    assign head_load_done  = head_resp_fire && ent_is_load[0];
    assign head_store_done = head_resp_fire && ent_is_store[0];

    assign load_complete_valid     = head_load_done;
    assign load_complete_rob_index = ent_rob[0];
    assign load_complete_prd       = ent_pdst[0];
    assign load_complete_data      = load_data;

    assign store_done_valid     = head_store_done;
    assign store_done_rob_index = ent_rob[0];

    assign store_commit_match_head = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[0] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[0]);
    assign store_commit_match_tail = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[1] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[1]);

    assign squash_head = flush && ent_valid[0] &&
                         !((ent_rob[0] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);
    assign squash_tail = flush && ent_valid[1] &&
                         !((ent_rob[1] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);

    assign head_remove = ent_valid[0] &&
                         (head_load_done || head_store_done || squash_head);
    assign tail_remove = ent_valid[1] && squash_tail;

    assign lsu_dcache_req_valid     = req_active || head_can_issue;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_we        = req_active ? req_we_q : ent_is_store[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_addr      = req_active ? req_addr_q : head_addr;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_wdata     = req_active ? req_wdata_q : head_wdata;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_be        = req_active ? req_be_q : head_be;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_rob_index = req_active ? req_rob_q : ent_rob[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_epoch     = req_active ? req_epoch_q : ent_epoch[0];

    assign lsu_dcache_wait = (req_active || ent_issued[0]) &&
                             !lsu_dcache_resp_valid;

    assign lsu_idle = !ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1] && !req_active;

    assign lsu_disp_ready = rst_n && !halted && !flush &&
                            (!ent_valid[0] || !ent_valid[1]);
    assign disp_fire = lsu_disp_valid && lsu_disp_ready;

    assign disp_to_head = disp_fire &&
                          (!ent_valid[0] ||
                           (head_remove && (!ent_valid[1] || tail_remove)));
    assign disp_to_tail = disp_fire && !disp_to_head &&
                          ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1];

    assign disp_rs1_eff = (lsu_disp_prs1 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs1_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1));
    assign disp_rs2_eff = (lsu_disp_prs2 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs2_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2));

    always_comb begin
        head_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[0];
        head_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[0];
        if (ent_valid[0] && !head_remove) begin
            if (head_rs1_wake) head_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (head_rs2_wake) head_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        tail_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[1];
        tail_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[1];
        if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            if (tail_rs1_wake) tail_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (tail_rs2_wake) tail_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        if (disp_to_head) begin
            head_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            head_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end else if (head_remove && ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            head_rs1_next = tail_rs1_ready_eff;
            head_rs2_next = tail_rs2_ready_eff;
        end

        if (disp_to_tail) begin
            tail_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            tail_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_insn[0]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_insn[1]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_rob[0]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_rob[1]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_prs1[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs1[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_rs1_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs1_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[0]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[1]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[0]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[1]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_epoch[0]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_epoch[1]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[1]  <= 1'b0;
            req_active        <= 1'b0;
            req_we_q          <= 1'b0;
            req_addr_q        <= 32'd0;
            req_wdata_q       <= 32'd0;
            req_be_q          <= 4'd0;
            req_rob_q         <= 4'd0;
            req_epoch_q       <= 2'd0;
        end else begin
            ent_rs1_ready[0] <= head_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[0] <= head_rs2_next;
            ent_rs1_ready[1] <= tail_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[1] <= tail_rs2_next;

            if (store_commit_match_head) ent_committed[0] <= 1'b1;
            if (store_commit_match_tail) ent_committed[1] <= 1'b1;

            if (head_issue_fire) begin
                ent_issued[0]    <= 1'b1;
            end
            if (head_resp_fire || head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_issued[0] <= 1'b0;
            end
            if (head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_epoch[0]  <= flush_epoch;
            end

            if (!req_active) begin
                if (head_can_issue && !lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active  <= 1'b1;
                    req_we_q    <= ent_is_store[0];
                    req_addr_q  <= head_addr;
                    req_wdata_q <= head_wdata;
                    req_be_q    <= head_be;
                    req_rob_q   <= ent_rob[0];
                    req_epoch_q <= ent_epoch[0];
                end
            end else begin
                if (lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active <= 1'b0;
                end
            end

            if (head_remove) begin
                if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                    ent_insn[0]       <= ent_insn[1];
                    ent_rob[0]        <= ent_rob[1];
                    ent_prs1[0]       <= ent_prs1[1];
                    ent_prs2[0]       <= ent_prs2[1];
                    ent_pdst[0]       <= ent_pdst[1];
                    ent_is_load[0]    <= ent_is_load[1];
                    ent_is_store[0]   <= ent_is_store[1];
                    ent_epoch[0]      <= ent_epoch[1];
                    ent_issued[0]     <= ent_issued[1];
                    ent_committed[0]  <= ent_committed[1] |
                                         store_commit_match_tail;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end
            end else if (tail_remove) begin
                ent_valid[1] <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (disp_to_head) begin
                ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[0]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[0]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[0]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[0]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[0]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[0]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[0]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end else if (disp_to_tail) begin
                ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[1]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[1]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[1]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[1]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[1]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[1]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[1]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/rv32i5.sv": "module rv32i5 (

  "rtl/execute_alu.sv": "module execute_alu (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        issue_valid,
    output logic        issue_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  issue_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_pdst,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand1,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand2,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_imm,
    input  logic [4:0]  issue_alu_op,
    input  logic [2:0]  issue_wb_sel,
    input  logic        issue_is_branch,
    input  logic        issue_is_jal,
    input  logic        issue_is_jalr,
    input  logic        issue_use_imm,
    input  logic        issue_is_auipc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        issue_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  issue_pred_type,
    output logic        alu_complete_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  alu_complete_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    output logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    output logic        resolve_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  resolve_rob_index,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_pc,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_actual
);

    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_ADD  = 5'd0;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SUB  = 5'd1;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLL  = 5'd2;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLT  = 5'd3;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLTU = 5'd4;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_XOR  = 5'd5;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRL  = 5'd6;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRA  = 5'd7;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_OR   = 5'd8;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AND  = 5'd9;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_PASSB= 5'd10;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BEQ  = 5'd11;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BNE  = 5'd12;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLT  = 5'd13;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGE  = 5'd14;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLTU = 5'd15;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGEU = 5'd16;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JAL  = 5'd17;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JALR = 5'd18;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_LUI  = 5'd19;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AUIPC= 5'd20;

    localparam logic [2:0] WB_ALU  = 3'b000;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_PC4  = 3'b001;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_LOAD = 3'b010;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_IMM  = 3'b011;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_AUIPC= 3'b100;

    logic [31:0] op_a;
    logic [31:0] op_b;
    logic [31:0] alu_result;
    logic [31:0] pc_plus4;
    logic [31:0] branch_target;
    logic [31:0] jal_target;
    logic [31:0] jalr_target;
    logic [31:0] ctrl_target;
    logic        branch_taken;
    logic        is_control;
    logic        actual_taken;
    logic [31:0] actual_next_pc;
    logic [31:0] wb_data;
    logic        issue_fire;

    assign issue_fire = issue_valid & issue_ready;

    assign op_a = issue_fire ? issue_operand1 : 32'd0;
    assign op_b = issue_fire ? (issue_use_imm ? issue_imm : issue_operand2) : 32'd0;

    always_comb begin
        alu_result = 32'd0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            case (issue_alu_op)
                ALU_ADD:   alu_result = op_a + op_b;
                ALU_SUB:   alu_result = op_a - op_b;
                ALU_SLL:   alu_result = op_a << op_b[4:0];
                ALU_SLT:   alu_result = ($signed(op_a) < $signed(op_b)) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
                ALU_SLTU:  alu_result = (op_a < op_b) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
                ALU_XOR:   alu_result = op_a ^ op_b;
                ALU_SRL:   alu_result = op_a >> op_b[4:0];
                ALU_SRA:   alu_result = $signed(op_a) >>> op_b[4:0];
                ALU_OR:    alu_result = op_a | op_b;
                ALU_AND:   alu_result = op_a & op_b;
                ALU_PASSB: alu_result = op_b;
                ALU_LUI:   alu_result = issue_imm;
                ALU_AUIPC: alu_result = issue_pc + issue_imm;
                default:   alu_result = op_a + op_b;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        branch_taken = 1'b0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            case (issue_alu_op)
                ALU_BEQ:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 == issue_operand2);
                ALU_BNE:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 != issue_operand2);
                ALU_BLT:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) < $signed(issue_operand2));
                ALU_BGE:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) >= $signed(issue_operand2));
                ALU_BLTU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 < issue_operand2);
                ALU_BGEU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 >= issue_operand2);
                default:  branch_taken = 1'b0;
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign pc_plus4      = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + 32'd4) : 32'd0;
    assign branch_target = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + issue_imm) : 32'd0;
    assign jal_target    = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + issue_imm) : 32'd0;
    assign jalr_target   = issue_fire ? ((op_a + issue_imm) & 32'hFFFF_FFFE) : 32'd0;

    always_comb begin
        ctrl_target = pc_plus4;
        if (issue_is_branch) begin
            ctrl_target = branch_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jal) begin
            ctrl_target = jal_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jalr) begin
            ctrl_target = jalr_target;
        end
    end

    assign is_control = issue_is_branch | issue_is_jal | issue_is_jalr;

    always_comb begin
        actual_taken = 1'b0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            if (issue_is_branch) begin
                actual_taken = branch_taken;
            end else if (issue_is_jal || issue_is_jalr) begin
                actual_taken = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign actual_next_pc = actual_taken ? ctrl_target : pc_plus4;

    always_comb begin
        wb_data = 32'd0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            wb_data = alu_result;
            case (issue_wb_sel)
                WB_ALU:   wb_data = alu_result;
                WB_PC4:   wb_data = pc_plus4;
                WB_LOAD:  wb_data = alu_result;
                WB_IMM:   wb_data = issue_imm;
                WB_AUIPC: wb_data = issue_pc + issue_imm;
                default:  wb_data = alu_result;
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign issue_ready = rst_n & ~halted & ~flush;

    assign alu_complete_valid    = issue_fire;
    assign alu_complete_rob_index= issue_rob_index;
    assign alu_complete_prd      = issue_pdst;
    assign alu_complete_data     = wb_data;

    assign resolve_valid     = issue_fire & is_control;
    assign resolve_rob_index = issue_rob_index;
    assign resolve_pc        = issue_pc;
    assign resolve_actual    = actual_next_pc;

endmodule

  "rtl/id_stage.sv": "module id_stage (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        ecall_pending,
    input  logic        fetch_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] fetch_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] fetch_insn,
    input  logic [31:0] fetch_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        fetch_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  fetch_pred_type,
    input  logic        fetch_pred_hit,
    output logic        id_valid,
    output logic [31:0] id_pc,
    output logic [31:0] id_insn,
    output logic [4:0]  id_rs1,
    output logic [4:0]  id_rs2,
    output logic [4:0]  id_rd,
    output logic [31:0] id_imm,
    output logic [4:0]  id_alu_op,
    output logic [2:0]  id_wb_sel,
    output logic        id_is_load,
    output logic        id_is_store,
    output logic [1:0]  id_mem_size,
    output logic        id_is_branch,
    output logic        id_is_jal,
    output logic        id_is_jalr,
    output logic        id_is_ecall,
    output logic        id_reg_write,
    output logic        id_use_imm,
    output logic        id_is_auipc,
    output logic [31:0] id_pred_next_pc,
    output logic        id_pred_taken,
    output logic [1:0]  id_pred_type,
    output logic        id_pred_hit
);

    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_ADD  = 5'd0;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SUB  = 5'd1;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLL  = 5'd2;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLT  = 5'd3;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLTU = 5'd4;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_XOR  = 5'd5;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRL  = 5'd6;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRA  = 5'd7;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_OR   = 5'd8;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AND  = 5'd9;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_PASS = 5'd10;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BEQ  = 5'd11;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BNE  = 5'd12;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLT  = 5'd13;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGE  = 5'd14;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLTU = 5'd15;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGEU = 5'd16;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JAL  = 5'd17;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JALR = 5'd18;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_LUI  = 5'd19;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AUIPC= 5'd20;

    localparam logic [2:0] WB_ALU  = 3'b000;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_PC4  = 3'b001;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_LOAD = 3'b010;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_IMM  = 3'b011;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_AUIPC= 3'b100;

    localparam logic [1:0] MS_BYTE = 2'b00;
    localparam logic [1:0] MS_HALF = 2'b01;
    localparam logic [1:0] MS_WORD = 2'b10;

    logic [6:0] opcode;
    logic [2:0] funct3;
    logic [6:0] funct7;

    logic [31:0] imm_i;
    logic [31:0] imm_s;
    logic [31:0] imm_b;
    logic [31:0] imm_u;
    logic [31:0] imm_j;

    logic [31:0] imm_sel;
    logic [4:0]  alu_op_c;
    logic [2:0]  wb_sel_c;
    logic        is_load_c;
    logic        is_store_c;
    logic [1:0]  mem_size_c;
    logic        is_branch_c;
    logic        is_jal_c;
    logic        is_jalr_c;
    logic        is_ecall_c;
    logic        reg_write_c;
    logic        use_imm_c;
    logic        is_auipc_c;

    assign opcode = fetch_insn[6:0];
    assign funct3 = fetch_insn[14:12];
    assign funct7 = fetch_insn[31:25];

    assign imm_i = {{20{fetch_insn[31]}}, fetch_insn[31:20]};
    assign imm_s = {{20{fetch_insn[31]}}, fetch_insn[31:25], fetch_insn[11:7]};
    assign imm_b = {{19{fetch_insn[31]}}, fetch_insn[31], fetch_insn[7],
                    fetch_insn[30:25], fetch_insn[11:8], 1'b0};
    assign imm_u = {fetch_insn[31:12], 12'b0};
    assign imm_j = {{11{fetch_insn[31]}}, fetch_insn[31], fetch_insn[19:12],
                    fetch_insn[20], fetch_insn[30:21], 1'b0};

    always_comb begin
        imm_sel    = 32'b0;
        alu_op_c   = ALU_ADD;
        wb_sel_c   = WB_ALU;
        is_load_c  = 1'b0;
        is_store_c = 1'b0;
        mem_size_c = MS_WORD;
        is_branch_c= 1'b0;
        is_jal_c   = 1'b0;
        is_jalr_c  = 1'b0;
        is_ecall_c = 1'b0;
        reg_write_c= 1'b0;
        use_imm_c  = 1'b0;
        is_auipc_c = 1'b0;

        case (opcode)
            7'b0110011: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_ALU;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b0;
                case (funct3)
                    3'b000: alu_op_c = funct7[5] ? ALU_SUB : ALU_ADD;
                    3'b001: alu_op_c = ALU_SLL;
                    3'b010: alu_op_c = ALU_SLT;
                    3'b011: alu_op_c = ALU_SLTU;
                    3'b100: alu_op_c = ALU_XOR;
                    3'b101: alu_op_c = funct7[5] ? ALU_SRA : ALU_SRL;
                    3'b110: alu_op_c = ALU_OR;
                    3'b111: alu_op_c = ALU_AND;
                    default: alu_op_c = ALU_ADD;
                endcase
            end
            7'b0010011: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_ALU;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_i;
                case (funct3)
                    3'b000: alu_op_c = ALU_ADD;
                    3'b001: alu_op_c = ALU_SLL;
                    3'b010: alu_op_c = ALU_SLT;
                    3'b011: alu_op_c = ALU_SLTU;
                    3'b100: alu_op_c = ALU_XOR;
                    3'b101: alu_op_c = funct7[5] ? ALU_SRA : ALU_SRL;
                    3'b110: alu_op_c = ALU_OR;
                    3'b111: alu_op_c = ALU_AND;
                    default: alu_op_c = ALU_ADD;
                endcase
            end
            7'b0000011: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_LOAD;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_i;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_ADD;
                is_load_c   = 1'b1;
                case (funct3)
                    3'b000: mem_size_c = MS_BYTE;
                    3'b001: mem_size_c = MS_HALF;
                    3'b010: mem_size_c = MS_WORD;
                    3'b100: mem_size_c = MS_BYTE;
                    3'b101: mem_size_c = MS_HALF;
                    default: mem_size_c = MS_WORD;
                endcase
            end
            7'b0100011: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b0;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_s;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_ADD;
                is_store_c  = 1'b1;
                case (funct3)
                    3'b000: mem_size_c = MS_BYTE;
                    3'b001: mem_size_c = MS_HALF;
                    3'b010: mem_size_c = MS_WORD;
                    default: mem_size_c = MS_WORD;
                endcase
            end
            7'b1100011: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b0;
                // Branches compare rs1 against rs2, not the branch immediate.
                use_imm_c   = 1'b0;
                imm_sel     = imm_b;
                is_branch_c = 1'b1;
                case (funct3)
                    3'b000: alu_op_c = ALU_BEQ;
                    3'b001: alu_op_c = ALU_BNE;
                    3'b100: alu_op_c = ALU_BLT;
                    3'b101: alu_op_c = ALU_BGE;
                    3'b110: alu_op_c = ALU_BLTU;
                    3'b111: alu_op_c = ALU_BGEU;
                    default: alu_op_c = ALU_BEQ;
                endcase
            end
            7'b1101111: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_PC4;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_j;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_JAL;
                is_jal_c    = 1'b1;
            end
            7'b1100111: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_PC4;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_i;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_JALR;
                is_jalr_c   = 1'b1;
            end
            7'b0110111: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_IMM;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_u;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_LUI;
            end
            7'b0010111: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_AUIPC;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_u;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_AUIPC;
                is_auipc_c  = 1'b1;
            end
            7'b1110011: begin

    for (g_win = 0; g_win < 8; g_win = g_win + 1) begin : gen_win
        logic [7:0] dup;
        for (g_dup = 0; g_dup < 8; g_dup = g_dup + 1) begin : gen_dup
            if (g_dup < g_win) begin : gen_less
                assign dup[g_dup] = order_elig[g_dup] &&
                                    (order_rd[5*g_dup +: 5] == order_rd[5*g_win +: 5]);
            end else begin : gen_ge
                assign dup[g_dup] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign win_ord[g_win] = order_elig[g_win] && !(|dup);

    assign rank_ord[7:4]   = {3'd0, order_elig[0]};
    assign rank_ord[11:8]  = {2'd0, order_elig[0]} + {2'd0, order_elig[1]};
    assign rank_ord[15:12] = {1'b0, order_elig[0]} + {1'b0, order_elig[1]} + {1'b0, order_elig[2]};
    assign rank_ord[19:16] = {3'd0, order_elig[0]} + {3'd0, order_elig[1]} + {3'd0, order_elig[2]} + {3'd0, order_elig[3]};
    assign rank_ord[23:20] = {3'd0, order_elig[0]} + {3'd0, order_elig[1]} + {3'd0, order_elig[2]} + {3'd0, order_elig[3]} + {3'd0, order_elig[4]};
    assign rank_ord[27:24] = {3'd0, order_elig[0]} + {3'd0, order_elig[1]} + {3'd0, order_elig[2]} + {3'd0, order_elig[3]} + {3'd0, order_elig[4]} + {3'd0, order_elig[5]};
    assign rank_ord[31:28] = {3'd0, order_elig[0]} + {3'd0, order_elig[1]} + {3'd0, order_elig[2]} + {3'd0, order_elig[3]} + {3'd0, order_elig[4]} + {3'd0, order_elig[5]} + {3'd0, order_elig[6]};

    genvar g_push;
    for (g_push = 0; g_push < 8; g_push = g_push + 1) begin : gen_push
        assign push_pos_ord[4*g_push +: 4] = free_tail + rank_ord[4*g_push +: 4];
    end

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, order_elig[0]} + {3'd0, order_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, order_elig[2]} + {3'd0, order_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, order_elig[4]} + {3'd0, order_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, order_elig[6]} + {3'd0, order_elig[7]};

    assign alloc_slot_idx  = do_alloc ? alloc_slot[2:0] : 3'd0;
    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[6*alloc_slot_idx +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[6*alloc_slot_idx +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    for (g_oh = 0; g_oh < 8; g_oh = g_oh + 1) begin : gen_win_oh
        for (g_bit = 0; g_bit < 32; g_bit = g_bit + 1) begin : gen_bit
            assign win_onehot[32*g_oh + g_bit] =

            win_onehot[0*32 + g_rest] | win_onehot[1*32 + g_rest] |
            win_onehot[2*32 + g_rest] | win_onehot[3*32 + g_rest] |
            win_onehot[4*32 + g_rest] | win_onehot[5*32 + g_rest] |
            win_onehot[6*32 + g_rest] | win_onehot[7*32 + g_rest];

        assign restore_val[6*g_rest +: 6] =
            (win_onehot[0*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[0*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[1*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[1*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[2*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[2*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[3*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[3*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[4*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[4*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[5*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[5*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[6*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[6*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[7*32 + g_rest] ? order_old[7*6 +: 6] : 6'd0);

    logic [3:0]  free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]  free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]  free_count_nxt;
    logic [3:0]  cur_tail_nxt;

    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (64'd1 << rd_prd) : 64'd0;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = do_alloc ? (free_tail + (alloc_push_en ? 4'd1 : 4'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_tail + flush_push_count) :
                                       free_tail;
    assign free_count_nxt = do_alloc ? (free_count + (alloc_push_en ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) - (need_pr ? 5'd1 : 5'd0)) :

                                       free_count;

                            do_alloc ? (rob_alloc_index + 4'd1) :
                                       cur_tail;

            free_tail  <= 4'd0;

    end

    genvar g_spec;
    for (g_spec = 0; g_spec < 32; g_spec = g_spec + 1) begin : gen_spec_state
        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                spec_map[6*g_spec +: 6] <= SPEC_INIT[6*g_spec +: 6];
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == g_spec)) begin

            end else if (do_flush && restore_hit[g_spec]) begin

            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_slot;
    for (g_slot = 0; g_slot < 8; g_slot = g_slot + 1) begin : gen_slot_state
        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= 6'd0;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= 6'd0;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= 5'd0;
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (do_flush && flush_elig[g_slot]) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= 6'd0;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= 6'd0;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= 5'd0;
            end else if (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == g_slot)) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= pdst_new;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= old_prd;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= id_rd;
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_free;
    for (g_free = 0; g_free < 16; g_free = g_free + 1) begin : gen_free_state
        logic       free_row_en;
        logic [5:0] free_row_data;

        always_comb begin
            free_row_en   = 1'b0;
            free_row_data = free_list[6*g_free +: 6];
            if (do_flush) begin
                if (order_elig[0] && (push_pos_ord[3:0] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[0*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[1] && (push_pos_ord[7:4] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[1*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[2] && (push_pos_ord[11:8] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[2*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[3] && (push_pos_ord[15:12] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[3*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[4] && (push_pos_ord[19:16] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[4*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[5] && (push_pos_ord[23:20] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[5*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[6] && (push_pos_ord[27:24] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[6*6 +: 6];
                end else if (order_elig[7] && (push_pos_ord[31:28] == g_free)) begin
                    free_row_en = 1'b1; free_row_data = order_pdst[7*6 +: 6];
                end
            end else if (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == g_free)) begin
                free_row_en   = 1'b1;
                free_row_data = alloc_push_data;
            end
        end

        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                free_list[6*g_free +: 6] <= FREE_INIT[6*g_free +: 6];
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (free_row_en) begin
                free_list[6*g_free +: 6] <= free_row_data;
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_ready;
    for (g_ready = 0; g_ready < 64; g_ready = g_ready + 1) begin : gen_ready_state
        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                ready_tbl[g_ready] <= 1'b1;
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (ready_clr[g_ready]) begin
                ready_tbl[g_ready] <= 1'b0;
            end else if (ready_set[g_ready]) begin
                ready_tbl[g_ready] <= 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
