    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        ecall_pending,
    input  logic        id_valid,
    output logic        id_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] id_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] id_insn,
    input  logic [4:0]  id_rs1,
    input  logic [4:0]  id_rs2,
    input  logic [4:0]  id_rd,
    input  logic [31:0] id_imm,
    input  logic [4:0]  id_alu_op,
    input  logic [2:0]  id_wb_sel,
    input  logic        id_is_load,
    input  logic        id_is_store,
    input  logic [1:0]  id_mem_size,
    input  logic        id_is_branch,
    input  logic        id_is_jal,
    input  logic        id_is_jalr,
    input  logic        id_is_ecall,
    input  logic        id_reg_write,
    input  logic        id_use_imm,
    input  logic        id_is_auipc,
    input  logic [31:0] id_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        id_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  id_pred_type,
    input  logic        id_pred_hit,
    output logic        rob_alloc_valid,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_ready,
    input  logic [3:0]  rob_alloc_index,
    output logic [31:0] rob_alloc_pc,
    output logic [31:0] rob_alloc_insn,
    output logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_pdst,
    output logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_old_prd,
    output logic [4:0]  rob_alloc_arch_rd,
    output logic        rob_alloc_is_control,
    output logic        rob_alloc_is_store,
    output logic        rob_alloc_is_ecall,
    output logic        rob_alloc_reg_write,
    output logic        iq_disp_valid,
    input  logic        iq_disp_ready,
    output logic [31:0] iq_disp_pc,
    output logic [31:0] iq_disp_insn,
    output logic [3:0]  iq_disp_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  iq_disp_prs1,
    output logic [5:0]  iq_disp_prs2,
    output logic [5:0]  iq_disp_pdst,
    output logic        iq_disp_rs1_ready,
    output logic        iq_disp_rs2_ready,
    output logic [31:0] iq_disp_imm,
    output logic [4:0]  iq_disp_alu_op,
    output logic [2:0]  iq_disp_wb_sel,
    output logic        iq_disp_is_branch,
    output logic        iq_disp_is_jal,
    output logic        iq_disp_is_jalr,
    output logic        iq_disp_use_imm,
    output logic        iq_disp_is_auipc,
    output logic [31:0] iq_disp_pred_next_pc,
    output logic        iq_disp_pred_taken,
    output logic [1:0]  iq_disp_pred_type,
    output logic        lsu_disp_valid,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_ready,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_disp_pc,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_disp_insn,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_disp_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs1,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs2,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_pdst,
    output logic        lsu_disp_rs1_ready,
    output logic        lsu_disp_rs2_ready,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_disp_imm,
    output logic        lsu_disp_is_load,
    output logic        lsu_disp_is_store,
    output logic [1:0]  lsu_disp_mem_size,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd
);

    localparam logic [5:0] PR_ZERO = 6'd0;

    logic [191:0] spec_map;
    logic [95:0]  free_list;
    logic [3:0]   free_head;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail;
    logic [4:0]   free_count;
    logic [63:0]  ready_tbl;

    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd;
    logic [3:0]   cur_tail;

    localparam logic [191:0] SPEC_INIT = {
        6'd31, 6'd30, 6'd29, 6'd28, 6'd27, 6'd26, 6'd25, 6'd24,
        6'd23, 6'd22, 6'd21, 6'd20, 6'd19, 6'd18, 6'd17, 6'd16,
        6'd15, 6'd14, 6'd13, 6'd12, 6'd11, 6'd10, 6'd9,  6'd8,
        6'd7,  6'd6,  6'd5,  6'd4,  6'd3,  6'd2,  6'd1,  6'd0
    };

    localparam logic [95:0] FREE_INIT = {
        6'd47, 6'd46, 6'd45, 6'd44, 6'd43, 6'd42, 6'd41, 6'd40,
        6'd39, 6'd38, 6'd37, 6'd36, 6'd35, 6'd34, 6'd33, 6'd32
    };

    logic [5:0]  rs1_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rs2_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rd_prd;
    logic [5:0]  old_prd;
    logic        rs1_rdy;
    logic        rs2_rdy;
    logic        need_pr;
    logic        free_avail;
    logic        is_ctrl;
    logic        is_mem;
    logic        is_alu;
    logic        do_alloc;
    logic        do_flush;
    logic [3:0]  alloc_slot;
    logic [5:0]  pdst_new;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs1;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs2;
    logic [5:0]  spec_old;
    logic [5:0]  free_head_data;
    logic [4:0]  spec_rs1_idx;
    logic [4:0]  spec_rs2_idx;
    logic [4:0]  spec_old_idx;
    logic [3:0]  free_head_idx;

    assign need_pr    = id_reg_write && (id_rd != 5'd0);
    assign free_avail = (free_count != 5'd0);
    assign is_ctrl    = id_is_branch || id_is_jal || id_is_jalr;
    assign is_mem     = id_is_load || id_is_store;
    assign is_alu     = !is_mem && !id_is_ecall;

    assign do_alloc = id_valid && !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign id_ready = !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign do_flush   = flush && !halted;
    assign alloc_slot = rob_alloc_index;

    assign spec_rs1_idx = (do_alloc && (id_rs1 != 5'd0)) ? id_rs1 : 5'd0;
    assign spec_rs2_idx = (do_alloc && (id_rs2 != 5'd0)) ? id_rs2 : 5'd0;
    assign spec_old_idx = (do_alloc && need_pr)         ? id_rd  : 5'd0;

    assign spec_rs1 = spec_map[6*spec_rs1_idx +: 6];
    assign spec_rs2 = spec_map[6*spec_rs2_idx +: 6];
    assign spec_old = spec_map[6*spec_old_idx +: 6];

    assign rs1_prd = (id_rs1 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs1;
    assign rs2_prd = (id_rs2 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs2;

    assign rs1_rdy = (rs1_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs1_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs1_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs1_prd)));
    assign rs2_rdy = (rs2_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs2_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs2_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs2_prd)));

    assign free_head_idx  = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? free_head : 4'd0;
    assign free_head_data = free_list[6*free_head_idx +: 6];

    assign rd_prd   = need_pr ? free_head_data : PR_ZERO;
    assign old_prd  = need_pr ? spec_old       : PR_ZERO;
    assign pdst_new = need_pr ? rd_prd         : PR_ZERO;

    assign rob_alloc_valid        = do_alloc;
    assign rob_alloc_pc           = id_pc;
    assign rob_alloc_insn         = id_insn;
    assign rob_alloc_pdst         = rd_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_old_prd      = old_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_arch_rd      = id_rd;
    assign rob_alloc_is_control   = is_ctrl;
    assign rob_alloc_is_store     = id_is_store;
    assign rob_alloc_is_ecall     = id_is_ecall;
    assign rob_alloc_reg_write    = need_pr;

    assign iq_disp_valid          = do_alloc && is_alu;
    assign iq_disp_pc             = id_pc;
    assign iq_disp_insn           = id_insn;
    assign iq_disp_rob_index      = rob_alloc_index;
    assign iq_disp_prs1           = rs1_prd;
    assign iq_disp_prs2           = rs2_prd;
    assign iq_disp_pdst           = rd_prd;
    assign iq_disp_rs1_ready      = rs1_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_rs2_ready      = rs2_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_imm            = id_imm;
    assign iq_disp_alu_op         = id_alu_op;
    assign iq_disp_wb_sel         = id_wb_sel;
    assign iq_disp_is_branch      = id_is_branch;
    assign iq_disp_is_jal         = id_is_jal;
    assign iq_disp_is_jalr        = id_is_jalr;
    assign iq_disp_use_imm        = id_use_imm;
    assign iq_disp_is_auipc       = id_is_auipc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_next_pc   = id_pred_next_pc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_taken     = id_pred_taken;
    assign iq_disp_pred_type      = id_pred_type;

    assign lsu_disp_valid         = do_alloc && is_mem;
    assign lsu_disp_pc            = id_pc;
    assign lsu_disp_insn          = id_insn;
    assign lsu_disp_rob_index     = rob_alloc_index;
    assign lsu_disp_prs1          = rs1_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_prs2          = rs2_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_pdst          = rd_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_rs1_ready     = rs1_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_rs2_ready     = rs2_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_imm           = id_imm;
    assign lsu_disp_is_load       = id_is_load;
    assign lsu_disp_is_store      = id_is_store;
    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    logic [3:0]    flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]    flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]    flush_elig;
    logic [7:0]    order_elig;
    logic [47:0]   order_pdst;
    logic [47:0]   order_old;
    logic [39:0]   order_rd;
    logic [7:0]    win_ord;
    logic [31:0]   rank_ord;
    logic [31:0]   push_pos_ord;
    logic [255:0]  win_onehot;
    logic [31:0]   restore_hit;
    logic [191:0]  restore_val;
    logic [3:0]    flush_push_count;
    logic [2:0]    alloc_slot_idx;
    logic [5:0]    alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]    alloc_slot_old;
    logic          alloc_push_en;
    logic [5:0]    alloc_push_data;

    assign flush_next4 = flush_rob_index + 4'd1;
    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);

    genvar g_ord;
    for (g_ord = 0; g_ord < 8; g_ord = g_ord + 1) begin : gen_order
        wire [2:0] idx = flush_next4[2:0] + g_ord;
        assign order_elig[g_ord] = flush_elig[idx];
        assign order_pdst[6*g_ord +: 6] = order_elig[g_ord] ? slot_pdst[6*idx +: 6] : 6'd0;
        assign order_old[6*g_ord +: 6]  = order_elig[g_ord] ? slot_old[6*idx +: 6]  : 6'd0;
        assign order_rd[5*g_ord +: 5]   = order_elig[g_ord] ? slot_rd[5*idx +: 5]   : 5'd0;
    end

    assign rank_ord[3:0]   = 4'd0;
    assign rank_ord[7:4]   = {3'd0, order_elig[0]};
    assign rank_ord[11:8]  = rank_ord[7:4]  + {3'd0, order_elig[1]};
    assign rank_ord[15:12] = rank_ord[11:8] + {3'd0, order_elig[2]};
    assign rank_ord[19:16] = rank_ord[15:12] + {3'd0, order_elig[3]};
    assign rank_ord[23:20] = rank_ord[19:16] + {3'd0, order_elig[4]};
    assign rank_ord[27:24] = rank_ord[23:20] + {3'd0, order_elig[5]};
    assign rank_ord[31:28] = rank_ord[27:24] + {3'd0, order_elig[6]};

    assign flush_push_count = rank_ord[31:28] + {3'd0, order_elig[7]};

    assign push_pos_ord[3:0]   = free_tail;
    assign push_pos_ord[7:4]   = push_pos_ord[3:0]   + {3'd0, order_elig[0]};
    assign push_pos_ord[11:8]  = push_pos_ord[7:4]   + {3'd0, order_elig[1]};
    assign push_pos_ord[15:12] = push_pos_ord[11:8]  + {3'd0, order_elig[2]};
    assign push_pos_ord[19:16] = push_pos_ord[15:12] + {3'd0, order_elig[3]};
    assign push_pos_ord[23:20] = push_pos_ord[19:16] + {3'd0, order_elig[4]};
    assign push_pos_ord[27:24] = push_pos_ord[23:20] + {3'd0, order_elig[5]};
    assign push_pos_ord[31:28] = push_pos_ord[27:24] + {3'd0, order_elig[6]};

    assign alloc_slot_idx  = do_alloc ? alloc_slot[2:0] : 3'd0;
    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[6*alloc_slot_idx +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[6*alloc_slot_idx +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    genvar g_win, g_dup;
    for (g_win = 0; g_win < 8; g_win = g_win + 1) begin : gen_win
        logic [7:0] dup;
        for (g_dup = 0; g_dup < 8; g_dup = g_dup + 1) begin : gen_dup
            if (g_dup < g_win) begin : gen_less
                assign dup[g_dup] = order_elig[g_dup] &&
                                    (order_rd[5*g_dup +: 5] == order_rd[5*g_win +: 5]);
            end else begin : gen_ge
                assign dup[g_dup] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign win_ord[g_win] = order_elig[g_win] && !(|dup);
    end

    genvar g_oh, g_bit;
    for (g_oh = 0; g_oh < 8; g_oh = g_oh + 1) begin : gen_win_oh
        for (g_bit = 0; g_bit < 32; g_bit = g_bit + 1) begin : gen_bit
            localparam logic [4:0] ARCH_IDX = g_bit;
            assign win_onehot[32*g_oh + g_bit] =
                win_ord[g_oh] && (order_rd[5*g_oh +: 5] == ARCH_IDX);
        end
    end

    genvar g_rest;
    for (g_rest = 0; g_rest < 32; g_rest = g_rest + 1) begin : gen_restore
        localparam logic [4:0] ARCH_IDX = g_rest;
        assign restore_hit[g_rest] =
            win_onehot[0*32 + ARCH_IDX] | win_onehot[1*32 + ARCH_IDX] |
            win_onehot[2*32 + ARCH_IDX] | win_onehot[3*32 + ARCH_IDX] |
            win_onehot[4*32 + ARCH_IDX] | win_onehot[5*32 + ARCH_IDX] |
            win_onehot[6*32 + ARCH_IDX] | win_onehot[7*32 + ARCH_IDX];

        assign restore_val[6*g_rest +: 6] =
            (win_onehot[0*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[0*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[1*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[1*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[2*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[2*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[3*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[3*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[4*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[4*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[5*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[5*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[6*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[6*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (win_onehot[7*32 + ARCH_IDX] ? order_old[7*6 +: 6] : 6'd0);
    end

    logic [3:0]  free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]  free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]  free_count_nxt;
    logic [3:0]  cur_tail_nxt;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = do_alloc ? (free_tail + (alloc_push_en ? 4'd1 : 4'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_tail + flush_push_count) :
                                       free_tail;
    assign free_count_nxt = do_alloc ? (free_count + (alloc_push_en ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) - (need_pr ? 5'd1 : 5'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_count + {1'b0, flush_push_count}) :
                                       free_count;
    assign cur_tail_nxt   = do_flush ? flush_next4 :
                            do_alloc ? (rob_alloc_index + 4'd1) :
                                       cur_tail;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (halted) begin
        end else begin
            if (do_alloc && need_pr) begin
                free_head <= free_head_nxt;
            end
            if (do_alloc || do_flush) begin
                free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
                free_count <= free_count_nxt;
                cur_tail   <= cur_tail_nxt;
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_spec;
    for (g_spec = 0; g_spec < 32; g_spec = g_spec + 1) begin : gen_spec_state
        localparam logic [4:0] ARCH_IDX = g_spec;
        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                spec_map[6*g_spec +: 6] <= SPEC_INIT[6*g_spec +: 6];
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ARCH_IDX)) begin
                spec_map[6*g_spec +: 6] <= rd_prd;
            end else if (do_flush && restore_hit[g_spec]) begin
                spec_map[6*g_spec +: 6] <= restore_val[6*g_spec +: 6];
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_slot;
    for (g_slot = 0; g_slot < 8; g_slot = g_slot + 1) begin : gen_slot_state
        localparam logic [2:0] SLOT_IDX = g_slot;
        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= 6'd0;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= 6'd0;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= 5'd0;
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (do_flush && flush_elig[g_slot]) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= 6'd0;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= 6'd0;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= 5'd0;
            end else if (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == SLOT_IDX)) begin
                slot_pdst[6*g_slot +: 6] <= pdst_new;
                slot_old[6*g_slot +: 6]  <= old_prd;
                slot_rd[5*g_slot +: 5]   <= id_rd;
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_free;
    for (g_free = 0; g_free < 16; g_free = g_free + 1) begin : gen_free_state
        localparam logic [3:0] ROW_IDX = g_free;
        logic [7:0] push_hit;
        logic       alloc_hit;
        logic       free_row_en;
        logic [5:0] free_row_data;
        genvar g_push;
        for (g_push = 0; g_push < 8; g_push = g_push + 1) begin : gen_push_hit
            assign push_hit[g_push] = order_elig[g_push] &&
                                      (push_pos_ord[4*g_push +: 4] == ROW_IDX);
        end
        assign alloc_hit   = do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == ROW_IDX);
        assign free_row_en = (|push_hit) || alloc_hit;
        assign free_row_data =
            (push_hit[0] ? order_pdst[0*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[1] ? order_pdst[1*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[2] ? order_pdst[2*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[3] ? order_pdst[3*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[4] ? order_pdst[4*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[5] ? order_pdst[5*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[6] ? order_pdst[6*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (push_hit[7] ? order_pdst[7*6 +: 6] : 6'd0) |
            (alloc_hit   ? alloc_push_data     : 6'd0);

        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                free_list[6*g_free +: 6] <= FREE_INIT[6*g_free +: 6];
            end else if (halted) begin
            end else if (free_row_en) begin
                free_list[6*g_free +: 6] <= free_row_data;
            end
        end
    end

    genvar g_ready;
    for (g_ready = 0; g_ready < 48; g_ready = g_ready + 1) begin : gen_ready_state
        localparam logic [5:0] PRD_IDX = g_ready;
        logic set_bit;
        logic clr_bit;
        assign set_bit = (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == PRD_IDX)) ||

    localparam logic [5:0] PR_ZERO = 6'd0;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rename / checkpoint state
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map;
    logic [95:0]  free_list;
    logic [3:0]   free_head;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail;
    logic [4:0]   free_count;
    logic [63:0]  ready_tbl;

    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd;
    logic [3:0]   cur_tail;

    localparam logic [191:0] SPEC_INIT = {
        6'd31, 6'd30, 6'd29, 6'd28, 6'd27, 6'd26, 6'd25, 6'd24,
        6'd23, 6'd22, 6'd21, 6'd20, 6'd19, 6'd18, 6'd17, 6'd16,
        6'd15, 6'd14, 6'd13, 6'd12, 6'd11, 6'd10, 6'd9,  6'd8,
        6'd7,  6'd6,  6'd5,  6'd4,  6'd3,  6'd2,  6'd1,  6'd0
    };

    localparam logic [95:0] FREE_INIT = {
        6'd47, 6'd46, 6'd45, 6'd44, 6'd43, 6'd42, 6'd41, 6'd40,
        6'd39, 6'd38, 6'd37, 6'd36, 6'd35, 6'd34, 6'd33, 6'd32
    };

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Decode / dispatch.  All combinational behaviour of this module is
    // expressed with continuous assignments and constant-index
    // (generate-time) part selects only.  There is no combinational
    // process in this module, therefore no latch can ever be inferred
    // and every next-state signal is driven on all paths by construction.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [5:0]  rs1_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rs2_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rd_prd;
    logic [5:0]  old_prd;
    logic        rs1_rdy;
    logic        rs2_rdy;
    logic        need_pr;
    logic        free_avail;
    logic        is_ctrl;
    logic        is_mem;
    logic        is_alu;
    logic        do_alloc;
    logic        do_flush;
    logic [3:0]  alloc_slot;
    logic [5:0]  pdst_new;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs1;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs2;
    logic [5:0]  spec_old;
    logic [5:0]  free_head_data;

    assign spec_rs1       = spec_map[6*id_rs1 +: 6];
    assign spec_rs2       = spec_map[6*id_rs2 +: 6];
    assign spec_old       = spec_map[6*id_rd  +: 6];
    assign free_head_data = free_list[6*free_head +: 6];

    assign rs1_prd = (id_rs1 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs1;
    assign rs2_prd = (id_rs2 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs2;

    assign rs1_rdy = (rs1_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs1_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs1_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs1_prd)));
    assign rs2_rdy = (rs2_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs2_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs2_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs2_prd)));

    assign need_pr    = id_reg_write && (id_rd != 5'd0);
    assign free_avail = (free_count != 5'd0);
    assign is_ctrl    = id_is_branch || id_is_jal || id_is_jalr;
    assign is_mem     = id_is_load || id_is_store;
    assign is_alu     = !is_mem && !id_is_ecall;

    assign do_alloc = id_valid && !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign id_ready = !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign do_flush   = flush && !halted;
    assign alloc_slot = rob_alloc_index;

    assign rd_prd   = need_pr ? free_head_data : PR_ZERO;
    assign old_prd  = need_pr ? spec_old       : PR_ZERO;
    assign pdst_new = need_pr ? rd_prd         : PR_ZERO;

    assign rob_alloc_valid        = do_alloc;
    assign rob_alloc_pc           = id_pc;
    assign rob_alloc_insn         = id_insn;
    assign rob_alloc_pdst         = rd_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_old_prd      = old_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_arch_rd      = id_rd;
    assign rob_alloc_is_control   = is_ctrl;
    assign rob_alloc_is_store     = id_is_store;
    assign rob_alloc_is_ecall     = id_is_ecall;
    assign rob_alloc_reg_write    = need_pr;

    assign iq_disp_valid          = do_alloc && is_alu;
    assign iq_disp_pc             = id_pc;
    assign iq_disp_insn           = id_insn;
    assign iq_disp_rob_index      = rob_alloc_index;
    assign iq_disp_prs1           = rs1_prd;
    assign iq_disp_prs2           = rs2_prd;
    assign iq_disp_pdst           = rd_prd;
    assign iq_disp_rs1_ready      = rs1_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_rs2_ready      = rs2_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_imm            = id_imm;
    assign iq_disp_alu_op         = id_alu_op;
    assign iq_disp_wb_sel         = id_wb_sel;
    assign iq_disp_is_branch      = id_is_branch;
    assign iq_disp_is_jal         = id_is_jal;
    assign iq_disp_is_jalr        = id_is_jalr;
    assign iq_disp_use_imm        = id_use_imm;
    assign iq_disp_is_auipc       = id_is_auipc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_next_pc   = id_pred_next_pc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_taken     = id_pred_taken;
    assign iq_disp_pred_type      = id_pred_type;

    assign lsu_disp_valid         = do_alloc && is_mem;
    assign lsu_disp_pc            = id_pc;
    assign lsu_disp_insn          = id_insn;
    assign lsu_disp_rob_index     = rob_alloc_index;
    assign lsu_disp_prs1          = rs1_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_prs2          = rs2_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_pdst          = rd_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_rs1_ready     = rs1_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_rs2_ready     = rs2_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_imm           = id_imm;
    assign lsu_disp_is_load       = id_is_load;
    assign lsu_disp_is_store      = id_is_store;
    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flush / free-list push helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [3:0]  flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]  flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]  flush_elig;
    logic [23:0] flush_rank;
    logic [31:0] flush_push_pos;
    logic [3:0]  flush_push_count;

    logic [5:0]  alloc_push_data;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_old;

    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    // rank[k] = number of eligible slots whose flush distance is smaller
    // than the distance of slot k (constant-index row decode, full drive).
    genvar gk;
    generate
        for (gk = 0; gk < 8; gk = gk + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gk +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_set;
    logic [63:0]  ready_clr;
    logic [7:0]   slot_win;

                       (load_complete_valid ? (64'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 64'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (64'd1 << rd_prd) : 64'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) );
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       rst_hit;
            logic [5:0] rst_val;

            assign rst_hit =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]));

            assign rst_val =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[5:0]   : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[11:6]  : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[17:12] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[23:18] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[29:24] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[35:30] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[41:36] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[47:42] : 6'd0);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga[4:0])) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && rst_hit)                       ? rst_val :
                                                              spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (flush_push_pos[3:0]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[0  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (flush_push_pos[7:4]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[6  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (flush_push_pos[11:8]  == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[12 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (flush_push_pos[15:12] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[18 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (flush_push_pos[19:16] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[24 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (flush_push_pos[23:20] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[30 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (flush_push_pos[27:24] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[36 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (flush_push_pos[31:28] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[42 +: 6] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl[3:0]))             ? alloc_push_data :
                                                                                     free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {64{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (halted) begin
        end else begin
            spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
            free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
            free_head  <= free_head_nxt;
            free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
            free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            ready_tbl  <= ready_nxt;
            slot_pdst  <= slot_pdst_nxt;
            slot_old   <= slot_old_nxt;
            slot_rd    <= slot_rd_nxt;

            if (do_flush) begin
                cur_tail <= flush_next4;
            end else if (do_alloc) begin
                cur_tail <= rob_alloc_index + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/dcache.sv": "module dcache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic        cpu_req_we,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_wdata,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_be,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_rdata,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic        mem_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  mem_req_be,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        dcache_mem_wait,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [2:0] ST_IDLE  = 3'd0;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_REFILL= 3'd1;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_WT    = 3'd2;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_RESP  = 3'd3;

    logic [2:0]  state;
    logic [127:0] line_data [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag  [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  req_be;
    logic        req_we;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0] refill_base;
    logic [1:0]  refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_data_next;
    logic [25:0] refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]  refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] wt_addr;
    logic [31:0] wt_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  wt_be;

    logic [31:0] resp_rdata;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch;

    logic [31:0] lookup_addr;
    logic [1:0]  idx;
    logic [25:0] tag;
    logic [1:0]  wsel;
    logic        hit;
    logic [127:0] hit_line;
    logic [31:0] hit_word;
    logic [31:0] be_mask;
    logic [31:0] merged_word;

    assign lookup_addr = (state == ST_IDLE) ? cpu_req_addr : req_addr;
    assign idx  = lookup_addr[5:4];
    assign tag  = lookup_addr[31:6];
    assign wsel = lookup_addr[3:2];
    assign hit  = line_valid[idx] && (line_tag[idx] == tag);
    assign hit_line = line_data[idx];

    always_comb begin
        case (wsel)
            2'd0:    hit_word = hit_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    hit_word = hit_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    hit_word = hit_line[95:64];
            default: hit_word = hit_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign be_mask = {{8{cpu_req_be[3]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[2]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[1]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[0]}}};
    assign merged_word = (hit_word & ~be_mask) | (cpu_req_wdata & be_mask);

    assign cpu_req_ready = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && ((state == ST_REFILL) || (state == ST_WT));
    assign mem_req_we    = (state == ST_WT);
    assign mem_req_addr  = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_addr : (refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00});
    assign mem_req_wdata = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_wdata : 32'b0;
    assign mem_req_be    = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_be : 4'b1111;

    assign dcache_mem_wait = mem_req_valid && !mem_req_ready;
    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_rdata = resp_rdata;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch;

    always_comb begin
        refill_data_next = refill_data;
        if ((state == ST_REFILL) && mem_req_ready) begin
            case (refill_word)
                2'd0: refill_data_next[31:0]   = mem_resp_data;
                2'd1: refill_data_next[63:32]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd2: refill_data_next[95:64]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd3: refill_data_next[127:96] = mem_resp_data;
                default: refill_data_next = refill_data;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : dcache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state       <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid  <= 4'b0;
            req_addr    <= 32'b0;
            req_wdata   <= 32'b0;
            req_be      <= 4'b0;
            req_we      <= 1'b0;
            req_rob     <= 4'b0;
            req_epoch   <= 2'b0;
            refill_base <= 32'b0;
            refill_word <= 2'b0;
            refill_data <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag  <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx  <= 2'b0;
            wt_addr     <= 32'b0;
            wt_wdata    <= 32'b0;
            wt_be       <= 4'b0;
            resp_rdata  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch  <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && cpu_req_ready) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                        req_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                        req_we    <= cpu_req_we;
                        req_rob   <= cpu_req_rob_index;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_req_we) begin
                            if (hit) begin
                                for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                    if (idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                        case (wsel)
                                            2'd0: line_data[r][31:0]    <= merged_word;
                                            2'd1: line_data[r][63:32]   <= merged_word;
                                            2'd2: line_data[r][95:64]   <= merged_word;
                                            default: line_data[r][127:96] <= merged_word;
                                        endcase
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            wt_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                            wt_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                            wt_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                            state    <= ST_WT;
                        end else if (hit) begin
                            resp_rdata <= hit_word;
                            resp_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b0;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_data_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            case (wsel)
                                2'd0:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[31:0];
                                2'd1:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[63:32];
                                2'd2:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[95:64];
                                default: resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[127:96];
                            endcase
                            resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_data <= refill_data_next;
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_WT: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        resp_rdata <= 32'b0;
                        resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                        state      <= ST_RESP;
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/icache.sv": "module icache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_data,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] ST_IDLE   = 2'd0;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_REFILL = 2'd1;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_RESP   = 2'd2;

    logic [1:0]   state;

    logic [127:0] line_data  [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag   [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0]  refill_base;
    logic [1:0]   refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_next;
    logic [25:0]  refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]   refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] resp_data_r;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch_r;

    logic [1:0]  cpu_idx;
    logic [25:0] cpu_tag;
    logic [1:0]  cpu_wsel;
    logic        cpu_hit;
    logic [31:0] cpu_word;
    logic [127:0] cpu_line;

    logic [1:0]  ref_wsel;
    logic [31:0] ref_word;

    assign cpu_idx  = cpu_req_addr[5:4];
    assign cpu_tag  = cpu_req_addr[31:6];
    assign cpu_wsel = cpu_req_addr[3:2];

    always_comb begin
        cpu_line = line_data[cpu_idx];
        cpu_hit  = line_valid[cpu_idx] && (line_tag[cpu_idx] == cpu_tag);
        case (cpu_wsel)
            2'd0:    cpu_word = cpu_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    cpu_word = cpu_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    cpu_word = cpu_line[95:64];
            default: cpu_word = cpu_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign ref_wsel = req_addr[3:2];
    always_comb begin
        case (ref_wsel)
            2'd0:    ref_word = refill_next[31:0];
            2'd1:    ref_word = refill_next[63:32];
            2'd2:    ref_word = refill_next[95:64];
            default: ref_word = refill_next[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    always_comb begin
        refill_next = refill_data;
        case (refill_word)
            2'd0:    refill_next[31:0]    = mem_resp_data;
            2'd1:    refill_next[63:32]   = mem_resp_data;
            2'd2:    refill_next[95:64]   = mem_resp_data;
            default: refill_next[127:96]  = mem_resp_data;
        endcase
    end

    assign cpu_req_ready  = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_data  = resp_data_r;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch_r;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_REFILL);
    assign mem_req_addr  = refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00};

    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : icache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state        <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid   <= 4'b0;
            req_addr     <= 32'b0;
            req_epoch    <= 2'b0;
            refill_base  <= 32'b0;
            refill_word  <= 2'b0;
            refill_data  <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag   <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx   <= 2'b0;
            resp_data_r  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch_r <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && !halted) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_hit) begin
                            resp_data_r  <= cpu_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b00;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready && mem_resp_valid) begin
                        refill_data <= refill_next;
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            resp_data_r  <= ref_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

    output logic        issue_is_jalr,
    output logic        issue_use_imm,
    output logic        issue_is_auipc,
    output logic [31:0] issue_pred_next_pc,
    output logic        issue_pred_taken,
    output logic [1:0]  issue_pred_type,
    output logic        dbg_ooo_issue,
    output logic        dbg_ooo_bypass
);

    localparam int IQ_DEPTH = 8;

    logic        ent_valid   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_pc      [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [3:0]  ent_rob     [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs1    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs2    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_pdst    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_r1rdy   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_r2rdy   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [4:0]  ent_alu_op  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [2:0]  ent_wb_sel  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_br      [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_jal     [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_jalr    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_useimm  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_auipc   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_prednpc [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_predtk  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [1:0]  ent_predty  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];

    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_ready;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_sel;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_uses1;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_uses2;

    logic        free_exist;
    logic [2:0]  free_idx;
    logic        sel_exist;
    logic [2:0]  sel_idx;
    logic        disp_fire;
    logic        issue_fire;
    logic        bypass_fire;
    logic        disp_uses1;
    logic        disp_uses2;

    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] flush_mask;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] valid_next;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] r1rdy_next;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] r2rdy_next;

    logic [31:0] sel_insn;
    logic [31:0] issue_imm_c;

    integer fi;
    integer rei;
    integer si;
    integer sei;
    integer fmi;
    integer rni;
    integer vni;
    integer rsti;
    integer dsi;

    always_comb begin
        free_exist = 1'b0;
        free_idx   = 3'd0;
        for (fi = 0; fi < IQ_DEPTH; fi = fi + 1) begin
            if (!ent_valid[fi] && !free_exist) begin
                free_exist = 1'b1;
                free_idx   = fi[2:0];
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (rei = 0; rei < IQ_DEPTH; rei = rei + 1) begin
            ent_uses1[rei] = ent_br[rei] || ent_jalr[rei] ||
                             (!ent_jal[rei] && !ent_auipc[rei] &&
                              !(ent_useimm[rei] && (ent_wb_sel[rei] == 3'b011)));
            ent_uses2[rei] = ent_br[rei] ||
                             (!ent_useimm[rei] && !ent_jal[rei] &&
                              !ent_jalr[rei] && !ent_auipc[rei]);
        end
    end

    assign disp_uses1 = iq_disp_is_branch || iq_disp_is_jalr ||
                        (!iq_disp_is_jal && !iq_disp_is_auipc &&
                         !(iq_disp_use_imm && (iq_disp_wb_sel == 3'b011)));
    assign disp_uses2 = iq_disp_is_branch ||
                        (!iq_disp_use_imm && !iq_disp_is_jal &&
                         !iq_disp_is_jalr && !iq_disp_is_auipc);

    always_comb begin
        for (rei = 0; rei < IQ_DEPTH; rei = rei + 1) begin
            ent_ready[rei] = ent_valid[rei] &&
                             (!ent_uses1[rei] || (ent_prs1[rei] == 6'd0) || ent_r1rdy[rei]) &&
                             (!ent_uses2[rei] || (ent_prs2[rei] == 6'd0) || ent_r2rdy[rei]);
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        sel_exist = 1'b0;
        sel_idx   = 3'd0;
        for (si = 0; si < IQ_DEPTH; si = si + 1) begin
            if (ent_ready[si] && !sel_exist) begin
                sel_exist = 1'b1;
                sel_idx   = si[2:0];
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (sei = 0; sei < IQ_DEPTH; sei = sei + 1) begin
            ent_sel[sei] = sel_exist && (sel_idx == sei[2:0]);
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        flush_mask = '0;
        for (fmi = 0; fmi < IQ_DEPTH; fmi = fmi + 1) begin
            if (flush && ent_valid[fmi]) begin
                if ((ent_rob[fmi] - rob_head_index) >=
                    (flush_rob_index - rob_head_index)) begin
                    flush_mask[fmi] = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (rni = 0; rni < IQ_DEPTH; rni = rni + 1) begin
            r1rdy_next[rni] = (ent_prs1[rni] == 6'd0) ? 1'b1 : ent_r1rdy[rni];
            r2rdy_next[rni] = (ent_prs2[rni] == 6'd0) ? 1'b1 : ent_r2rdy[rni];
            if (ent_valid[rni]) begin
                if (alu_complete_valid && (ent_prs1[rni] == alu_complete_prd) && (ent_prs1[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r1rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (load_complete_valid && (ent_prs1[rni] == load_complete_prd) && (ent_prs1[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r1rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (alu_complete_valid && (ent_prs2[rni] == alu_complete_prd) && (ent_prs2[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r2rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (load_complete_valid && (ent_prs2[rni] == load_complete_prd) && (ent_prs2[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r2rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (vni = 0; vni < IQ_DEPTH; vni = vni + 1) begin
            valid_next[vni] = ent_valid[vni];
            if (flush_mask[vni]) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b0;
            end
            if (issue_fire && (sel_idx == vni[2:0])) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b0;
            end
            if (disp_fire && (free_idx == vni[2:0])) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign disp_fire  = iq_disp_valid && iq_disp_ready && !halted;
    assign issue_fire = issue_valid && issue_ready && !halted;
    assign bypass_fire = issue_fire && (ent_rob[sel_idx] != rob_head_index);

    assign iq_disp_ready = free_exist && !halted && !flush;
    assign issue_valid = sel_exist && !halted && !flush;

    assign sel_insn = ent_insn[sel_idx];

    always_comb begin
        case (sel_insn[6:0])
            7'b0010011, 7'b0000011, 7'b1100111:
                issue_imm_c = {{20{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31:20]};
            7'b0100011:
                issue_imm_c = {{20{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31:25], sel_insn[11:7]};
            7'b1100011:
                issue_imm_c = {{19{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31], sel_insn[7],
                               sel_insn[30:25], sel_insn[11:8], 1'b0};
            7'b0110111, 7'b0010111:
                issue_imm_c = {sel_insn[31:12], 12'b0};
            7'b1101111:
                issue_imm_c = {{11{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31], sel_insn[19:12],
                               sel_insn[20], sel_insn[30:21], 1'b0};
            default:
                issue_imm_c = 32'b0;
        endcase
    end

    assign issue_pc          = ent_pc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_insn        = ent_insn[sel_idx];
    assign issue_rob_index   = ent_rob[sel_idx];
    assign issue_prs1        = ent_prs1[sel_idx];
    assign issue_prs2        = ent_prs2[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pdst        = ent_pdst[sel_idx];
    assign issue_operand1    = iq_prf_rdata1;
    assign issue_operand2    = iq_prf_rdata2;
    assign issue_imm         = issue_imm_c;
    assign issue_alu_op      = ent_alu_op[sel_idx];
    assign issue_wb_sel      = ent_wb_sel[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_branch   = ent_br[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_jal      = ent_jal[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_jalr     = ent_jalr[sel_idx];
    assign issue_use_imm     = ent_useimm[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_auipc    = ent_auipc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_next_pc= ent_prednpc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_taken  = ent_predtk[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_type   = ent_predty[sel_idx];

    assign iq_prf_rs1_addr = ent_prs1[sel_idx];
    assign iq_prf_rs2_addr = ent_prs2[sel_idx];

    assign dbg_ooo_issue  = issue_fire;
    assign dbg_ooo_bypass = bypass_fire;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (rsti = 0; rsti < IQ_DEPTH; rsti = rsti + 1) begin
                ent_valid[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_pc[rsti]      <= 32'd0;
                ent_insn[rsti]    <= 32'd0;
                ent_rob[rsti]     <= 4'd0;
                ent_prs1[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_prs2[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_pdst[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_r1rdy[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_r2rdy[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_alu_op[rsti]  <= 5'd0;
                ent_wb_sel[rsti]  <= 3'd0;
                ent_br[rsti]      <= 1'b0;
                ent_jal[rsti]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_jalr[rsti]    <= 1'b0;
                ent_useimm[rsti]  <= 1'b0;
                ent_auipc[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_prednpc[rsti] <= 32'd0;
                ent_predtk[rsti]  <= 1'b0;
                ent_predty[rsti]  <= 2'd0;
            end
        end else begin
            for (rsti = 0; rsti < IQ_DEPTH; rsti = rsti + 1) begin
                ent_valid[rsti] <= valid_next[rsti];
                if (valid_next[rsti]) begin
                    ent_r1rdy[rsti] <= r1rdy_next[rsti];
                    ent_r2rdy[rsti] <= r2rdy_next[rsti];
                end else begin
                    ent_r1rdy[rsti] <= 1'b0;
                    ent_r2rdy[rsti] <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
            if (disp_fire) begin
                for (dsi = 0; dsi < IQ_DEPTH; dsi = dsi + 1) begin
                    if (free_idx == dsi[2:0]) begin
                        ent_pc[dsi]      <= iq_disp_pc;
                        ent_insn[dsi]    <= iq_disp_insn;
                        ent_rob[dsi]     <= iq_disp_rob_index;
                        ent_prs1[dsi]    <= iq_disp_prs1;
                        ent_prs2[dsi]    <= iq_disp_prs2;
                        ent_pdst[dsi]    <= iq_disp_pdst;
                        ent_r1rdy[dsi]   <= !disp_uses1 || (iq_disp_prs1 == 6'd0) || iq_disp_rs1_ready ||
                                             (alu_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs1 == alu_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs1 != 6'd0)) ||
                                             (load_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs1 == load_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs1 != 6'd0));
                        ent_r2rdy[dsi]   <= !disp_uses2 || (iq_disp_prs2 == 6'd0) || iq_disp_rs2_ready ||
                                             (alu_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs2 == alu_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs2 != 6'd0)) ||
                                             (load_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs2 == load_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs2 != 6'd0));
                        ent_alu_op[dsi]  <= iq_disp_alu_op;
                        ent_wb_sel[dsi]  <= iq_disp_wb_sel;
                        ent_br[dsi]      <= iq_disp_is_branch;
                        ent_jal[dsi]     <= iq_disp_is_jal;
                        ent_jalr[dsi]    <= iq_disp_is_jalr;
                        ent_useimm[dsi]  <= iq_disp_use_imm;
                        ent_auipc[dsi]   <= iq_disp_is_auipc;
                        ent_prednpc[dsi] <= iq_disp_pred_next_pc;
                        ent_predtk[dsi]  <= iq_disp_pred_taken;
                        ent_predty[dsi]  <= iq_disp_pred_type;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/reorder_buffer.sv": "module reorder_buffer (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_valid,
    output logic        rob_alloc_ready,
    output logic [3:0]  rob_alloc_index,
    input  logic [31:0] rob_alloc_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] rob_alloc_insn,
    input  logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_pdst,
    input  logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_old_prd,
    input  logic [4:0]  rob_alloc_arch_rd,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_control,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_store,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_ecall,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_reg_write,
    output logic [3:0]  rob_head_index,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  alu_complete_rob_index,
    input  logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  load_complete_rob_index,
    input  logic [31:0] load_complete_data,
    input  logic        resolve_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  resolve_rob_index,
    input  logic        resolve_mispredict,
    input  logic [31:0] resolve_actual_next_pc,
    output logic        store_commit_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  store_commit_rob_index,
    input  logic        store_done_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  store_done_rob_index,
    output logic        commit_valid,
    output logic [31:0] commit_pc,
    output logic [31:0] commit_insn,
    output logic [31:0] commit_value,
    output logic [4:0]  commit_arch_rd,
    output logic        commit_reg_write,
    output logic        commit_is_ecall,
    output logic        commit_old_prd_valid,
    output logic [5:0]  commit_old_prd,
    output logic        flush_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    output logic [31:0] flush_pc,
    output logic        ecall_pending
);

    localparam integer ROB_DEPTH = 8;

    logic [3:0] head;
    logic [3:0] tail;
    logic [3:0] count;

    logic        ent_valid    [0:7];
    logic [3:0]  ent_index    [0:7];
    logic        ent_complete [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_store [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_ecall [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_ctrl  [0:7];
    logic        ent_store_done [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_pc     [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn   [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_value  [0:7];
    logic [4:0]  ent_arch_rd[0:7];
    logic        ent_reg_write [0:7];

    logic [2:0] head_slot;
    logic [2:0] tail_slot;
    assign head_slot = head[2:0];
    assign tail_slot = tail[2:0];

    logic [3:0] tail_plus1;
    logic [3:0] head_plus1;
    logic       alloc_fire;
    logic       full;
    logic       empty;

    logic       head_valid;
    logic       head_complete;
    logic       head_is_store;
    logic       head_is_ecall;
    logic       head_store_done;
    logic       head_ready;
    logic       commit_fire;
    logic       commit_pop;

    logic       flush_fire;
    logic [3:0] flush_idx4;
    logic [3:0] flush_next4;
    logic [3:0] flush_pos4;
    logic [3:0] flush_keep4;
    logic [3:0] flush_cnt4;

    logic       pending_flush;
    logic [3:0] pending_flush_idx;
    logic [31:0] pending_flush_pc;

    integer ec_i;
    integer sq_i;

    assign tail_plus1 = tail + 4'd1;
    assign head_plus1 = head + 4'd1;
    assign full  = (count == 4'd8);
    assign empty = (count == 4'd0);

    assign alloc_fire = rob_alloc_valid && rob_alloc_ready;
    assign rob_alloc_ready = rst_n && !halted && !full && !ecall_pending && !flush_fire;
    assign rob_alloc_index = tail;

    assign rob_head_index = head;

    assign head_valid      = ent_valid[head_slot];
    assign head_complete   = ent_complete[head_slot];
    assign head_is_store   = ent_is_store[head_slot];
    assign head_is_ecall   = ent_is_ecall[head_slot];
    assign head_store_done = ent_store_done[head_slot];

    assign head_ready = head_valid && head_complete &&
                        (!head_is_store || head_store_done);

    assign commit_fire = head_ready && !halted && !flush_fire;

    assign commit_pop = commit_fire && !head_is_ecall;

    assign commit_valid      = commit_fire;
    assign commit_pc         = ent_pc[head_slot];
    assign commit_insn       = ent_insn[head_slot];
    assign commit_value      = ent_value[head_slot];
    assign commit_arch_rd    = ent_arch_rd[head_slot];
    assign commit_reg_write  = ent_reg_write[head_slot];
    assign commit_is_ecall   = ent_is_ecall[head_slot];
    assign commit_old_prd_valid = ent_reg_write[head_slot];
    assign commit_old_prd    = 6'd0;

    assign store_commit_valid     = head_valid && head_is_store && !halted && !flush_fire;
    assign store_commit_rob_index = head;

    assign flush_fire = pending_flush && !halted;
    assign flush_idx4 = pending_flush_idx;
    assign flush_next4 = flush_idx4 + 4'd1;
    assign flush_pos4 = flush_idx4 - head;
    assign flush_keep4 = flush_pos4 + 4'd1;
    assign flush_cnt4 = count - flush_keep4;
    assign flush_valid = flush_fire;
    assign flush_rob_index = flush_idx4;
    assign flush_pc = pending_flush_pc;

    always_comb begin
        ecall_pending = 1'b0;
        for (ec_i = 0; ec_i < 8; ec_i = ec_i + 1) begin
            if (ent_valid[ec_i] && ent_is_ecall[ec_i]) begin
                ecall_pending = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            head <= 4'd0;
            tail <= 4'd0;
            count <= 4'd0;
            pending_flush <= 1'b0;
            pending_flush_idx <= 4'd0;
            pending_flush_pc <= 32'd0;
            for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                ent_valid[sq_i]          <= 1'b0;
                ent_index[sq_i]          <= 4'd0;
                ent_complete[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                ent_is_store[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                ent_is_ecall[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                ent_is_ctrl[sq_i]        <= 1'b0;
                ent_store_done[sq_i]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_pc[sq_i]             <= 32'd0;
                ent_insn[sq_i]           <= 32'd0;
                ent_value[sq_i]          <= 32'd0;
                ent_arch_rd[sq_i]        <= 5'd0;
                ent_reg_write[sq_i]      <= 1'b0;
            end
        end else if (halted) begin
            head  <= head;
            tail  <= tail;
            count <= count;
            pending_flush <= pending_flush;
            pending_flush_idx <= pending_flush_idx;
            pending_flush_pc <= pending_flush_pc;
        end else begin
            if (flush_fire) begin
                for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                    if ({1'b0, (sq_i[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4) begin
                        ent_valid[sq_i]          <= 1'b0;
                        ent_complete[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                        ent_is_store[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                        ent_is_ecall[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                        ent_is_ctrl[sq_i]        <= 1'b0;
                        ent_store_done[sq_i]     <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                tail <= flush_next4;
                count <= flush_keep4;
                pending_flush <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (commit_pop) begin
                    for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                        if (head_slot == sq_i[2:0]) begin
                            ent_valid[sq_i]          <= 1'b0;
                            ent_complete[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_store[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_ecall[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_ctrl[sq_i]        <= 1'b0;
                            ent_store_done[sq_i]     <= 1'b0;
                        end
                    end
                    head <= head_plus1;
                end

                if (alloc_fire) begin
                    for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                        if (tail_slot == sq_i[2:0]) begin
                            ent_valid[sq_i]           <= 1'b1;
                            ent_index[sq_i]           <= tail;
                            ent_complete[sq_i]        <= rob_alloc_is_ecall;
                            ent_is_store[sq_i]        <= rob_alloc_is_store;
                            ent_is_ecall[sq_i]        <= rob_alloc_is_ecall;
                            ent_is_ctrl[sq_i]         <= rob_alloc_is_control;
                            ent_store_done[sq_i]      <= 1'b0;
                            ent_pc[sq_i]              <= rob_alloc_pc;
                            ent_insn[sq_i]            <= rob_alloc_insn;
                            ent_value[sq_i]           <= 32'd0;
                            ent_arch_rd[sq_i]         <= rob_alloc_arch_rd;
                            ent_reg_write[sq_i]       <= rob_alloc_reg_write;
                        end
                    end
                    tail <= tail_plus1;
                end

                if (commit_pop && alloc_fire) begin
                    count <= count;
                end else if (commit_pop) begin
                    count <= count - 4'd1;
                end else if (alloc_fire) begin
                    count <= count + 4'd1;
                end
            end

            if (alu_complete_valid) begin
                for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                    if (alu_complete_rob_index[2:0] == sq_i[2:0]) begin
                        if (ent_valid[sq_i] &&
                            (ent_index[sq_i] == alu_complete_rob_index)) begin
                            ent_complete[sq_i] <= 1'b1;
                            ent_value[sq_i]    <= alu_complete_data;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if (load_complete_valid) begin
                for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                    if (load_complete_rob_index[2:0] == sq_i[2:0]) begin
                        if (ent_valid[sq_i] &&
                            (ent_index[sq_i] == load_complete_rob_index)) begin
                            ent_complete[sq_i] <= 1'b1;
                            ent_value[sq_i]    <= load_complete_data;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

  "rtl/execute_alu.sv": "module execute_alu (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        issue_valid,
    output logic        issue_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  issue_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_pdst,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand1,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand2,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_imm,
    input  logic [4:0]  issue_alu_op,
    input  logic [2:0]  issue_wb_sel,
    input  logic        issue_is_branch,
    input  logic        issue_is_jal,
    input  logic        issue_is_jalr,
    input  logic        issue_use_imm,
    input  logic        issue_is_auipc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        issue_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  issue_pred_type,
    output logic        alu_complete_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  alu_complete_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    output logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    output logic        resolve_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  resolve_rob_index,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_pc,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_actual
);

    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_ADD  = 5'd0;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SUB  = 5'd1;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLL  = 5'd2;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLT  = 5'd3;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLTU = 5'd4;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_XOR  = 5'd5;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRL  = 5'd6;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRA  = 5'd7;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_OR   = 5'd8;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AND  = 5'd9;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_PASSB= 5'd10;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BEQ  = 5'd11;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BNE  = 5'd12;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLT  = 5'd13;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGE  = 5'd14;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLTU = 5'd15;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGEU = 5'd16;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JAL  = 5'd17;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JALR = 5'd18;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_LUI  = 5'd19;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AUIPC= 5'd20;

    localparam logic [2:0] WB_ALU  = 3'b000;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_PC4  = 3'b001;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_LOAD = 3'b010;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_IMM  = 3'b011;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_AUIPC= 3'b100;

    logic [31:0] op_a;
    logic [31:0] op_b;
    logic [31:0] alu_result;
    logic [31:0] pc_plus4;
    logic [31:0] branch_target;
    logic [31:0] jal_target;
    logic [31:0] jalr_target;
    logic [31:0] ctrl_target;
    logic        branch_taken;
    logic        is_control;
    logic        actual_taken;
    logic [31:0] actual_next_pc;
    logic [31:0] wb_data;

    assign op_a = issue_operand1;
    assign op_b = issue_use_imm ? issue_imm : issue_operand2;

    always_comb begin
        alu_result = 32'd0;
        case (issue_alu_op)
            ALU_ADD:   alu_result = op_a + op_b;
            ALU_SUB:   alu_result = op_a - op_b;
            ALU_SLL:   alu_result = op_a << op_b[4:0];
            ALU_SLT:   alu_result = ($signed(op_a) < $signed(op_b)) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
            ALU_SLTU:  alu_result = (op_a < op_b) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
            ALU_XOR:   alu_result = op_a ^ op_b;
            ALU_SRL:   alu_result = op_a >> op_b[4:0];
            ALU_SRA:   alu_result = $signed(op_a) >>> op_b[4:0];
            ALU_OR:    alu_result = op_a | op_b;
            ALU_AND:   alu_result = op_a & op_b;
            ALU_PASSB: alu_result = op_b;
            ALU_LUI:   alu_result = issue_imm;
            ALU_AUIPC: alu_result = issue_pc + issue_imm;
            default:   alu_result = op_a + op_b;
        endcase
    end

    always_comb begin
        branch_taken = 1'b0;
        case (issue_alu_op)
            ALU_BEQ:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 == issue_operand2);
            ALU_BNE:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 != issue_operand2);
            ALU_BLT:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) < $signed(issue_operand2));
            ALU_BGE:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) >= $signed(issue_operand2));
            ALU_BLTU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 < issue_operand2);
            ALU_BGEU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 >= issue_operand2);
            default:  branch_taken = 1'b0;
        endcase
    end

    assign pc_plus4      = issue_pc + 32'd4;
    assign branch_target = issue_pc + issue_imm;
    assign jal_target    = issue_pc + issue_imm;
    assign jalr_target   = (op_a + issue_imm) & 32'hFFFF_FFFE;

    always_comb begin
        ctrl_target = issue_pc + 32'd4;
        if (issue_is_branch) begin
            ctrl_target = branch_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jal) begin
            ctrl_target = jal_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jalr) begin
            ctrl_target = jalr_target;
        end
    end

    assign is_control = issue_is_branch | issue_is_jal | issue_is_jalr;

    always_comb begin
        actual_taken = 1'b0;
        if (issue_is_branch) begin
            actual_taken = branch_taken;
        end else if (issue_is_jal || issue_is_jalr) begin
            actual_taken = 1'b1;
        end
    end

    assign actual_next_pc = actual_taken ? ctrl_target : pc_plus4;

    always_comb begin
        wb_data = alu_result;
        case (issue_wb_sel)
            WB_ALU:   wb_data = alu_result;
            WB_PC4:   wb_data = pc_plus4;
            WB_LOAD:  wb_data = alu_result;
            WB_IMM:   wb_data = issue_imm;
            WB_AUIPC: wb_data = issue_pc + issue_imm;
            default:  wb_data = alu_result;
        endcase
    end

    assign issue_ready = rst_n & ~halted & ~flush;

    assign alu_complete_valid    = issue_valid & issue_ready;
    assign alu_complete_rob_index= issue_rob_index;
    assign alu_complete_prd      = issue_pdst;
    assign alu_complete_data     = wb_data;

    assign resolve_valid     = issue_valid & issue_ready & is_control;
    assign resolve_rob_index = issue_rob_index;
    assign resolve_pc        = issue_pc;
    assign resolve_actual    = actual_next_pc;

endmodule

        .mem_resp_valid   (dc_mem_resp_valid),
