    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    // rank[k] = number of eligible slots whose flush distance is smaller
    // than the distance of slot k (constant-index row decode, full drive).
    genvar gk;
    generate
        for (gk = 0; gk < 8; gk = gk + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gk +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_set;
    logic [63:0]  ready_clr;
    logic [7:0]   slot_win;

    assign ready_set = (alu_complete_valid  ? (64'd1 << alu_complete_prd)  : 64'd0) |
                       (load_complete_valid ? (64'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 64'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (64'd1 << rd_prd) : 64'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = do_alloc ? (free_tail + (alloc_push_en ? 4'd1 : 4'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_tail + flush_push_count) :
                                       free_tail;
    assign free_count_nxt = do_alloc ? (free_count + (alloc_push_en ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) - (need_pr ? 5'd1 : 5'd0)) :
                            do_flush ? (free_count + {1'b0, flush_push_count}) :
                                       free_count;

    // Restore winner per checkpoint slot: eligible and no younger eligible
    // slot targets the same architectural register.
    genvar gw;
    generate
        for (gw = 0; gw < 8; gw = gw + 1) begin : gen_slot_win
            assign slot_win[gw] = flush_elig[gw] &&
                !( (flush_elig[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) );
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       rst_hit;
            logic [5:0] rst_val;

            assign rst_hit =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]));

            assign rst_val =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[5:0]   : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[11:6]  : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[17:12] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[23:18] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[29:24] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[35:30] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[41:36] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[47:42] : 6'd0);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga[4:0])) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && rst_hit)                       ? rst_val :
                                                              spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (flush_push_pos[3:0]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[0  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (flush_push_pos[7:4]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[6  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (flush_push_pos[11:8]  == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[12 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (flush_push_pos[15:12] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[18 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (flush_push_pos[19:16] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[24 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (flush_push_pos[23:20] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[30 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (flush_push_pos[27:24] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[36 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (flush_push_pos[31:28] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[42 +: 6] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl[3:0]))             ? alloc_push_data :
                                                                                     free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {64{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (halted) begin
        end else begin
            if (do_alloc || do_flush) begin
                spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
                slot_pdst  <= slot_pdst_nxt;
                slot_old   <= slot_old_nxt;
                slot_rd    <= slot_rd_nxt;
                free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
                free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
                free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            end
            if (do_alloc && need_pr) begin
                free_head <= free_head_nxt;
            end
            if (do_alloc || do_flush || alu_complete_valid || load_complete_valid) begin
                ready_tbl <= ready_nxt;
            end

            if (do_flush) begin
                cur_tail <= flush_next4;
            end else if (do_alloc) begin
                cur_tail <= rob_alloc_index + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/physical_register_file.sv": "module physical_register_file (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] load_complete_data
);

    // The physical-register address is 6 bits wide, so the file must cover
    // all 64 physical registers.  With only 40 entries, writes to allocated
    // physical registers 40..63 were silently dropped and reads returned X.
    // Those X operands propagate into branch/JALR targets and memory
    // addresses, poisoning the predictor BTB and stalling the cache/bus
    // handshakes (the simulation watchdog timeout with no retire mismatches).
    logic [31:0] prf [0:63];

    logic [31:0] iq_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] iq_rdata2_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata2_r;

    integer i;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 64; i = i + 1) begin
                prf[i] <= 32'h0000_0000;
            end
        end else begin
            // Physical register 0 is the architectural x0 and is hardwired.
            prf[0] <= 32'h0000_0000;
            if (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0)) begin
                prf[alu_complete_prd] <= alu_complete_data;
            end
            if (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0)) begin
                prf[load_complete_prd] <= load_complete_data;
            end
        end
    end

    // Write-first (read-during-write) behaviour.  A consumer that is woken by
    // a completion and issues in the same cycle must observe the newly
    // produced value, not the old register-array contents.  Without this the
    // LSU/IQ would compute operands (and memory addresses) from stale data in
    // exactly the cycle the producing ALU/load completes.  The load write
    // port has priority, matching the array write order above.
    always_comb begin
        iq_rdata1_r = (iq_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf[iq_prf_rs1_addr];
        iq_rdata2_r = (iq_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf[iq_prf_rs2_addr];
        lsu_rdata1_r = (lsu_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf[lsu_prf_rs1_addr];
        lsu_rdata2_r = (lsu_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf[lsu_prf_rs2_addr];
    end

    assign iq_prf_rdata1  = iq_rdata1_r;
    assign iq_prf_rdata2  = iq_rdata2_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata1 = lsu_rdata1_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata2 = lsu_rdata2_r;

endmodule

  "rtl/load_store_unit.sv": "module load_store_unit (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_valid,
    output logic        lsu_disp_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  lsu_disp_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_pdst,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_rs1_ready,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_rs2_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_imm,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_is_load,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_is_store,
    input  logic [1:0]  lsu_disp_mem_size,

    output logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs1_addr,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs2_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata1,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic        store_commit_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  store_commit_rob_index,
    output logic        store_done_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  store_done_rob_index,
    output logic        load_complete_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  load_complete_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    output logic [31:0] load_complete_data,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_valid,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_be,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_rob_index,
    output logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_req_epoch,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_req_ready,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_resp_rdata,
    input  logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_resp_epoch,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_wait,
    output logic        lsu_idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_BYTE = 2'b00;
    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_HALF = 2'b01;

    logic        ent_valid     [0:1];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn      [0:1];
    logic [3:0]  ent_rob       [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs1      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs2      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_pdst      [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs1_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs2_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_load   [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_store  [0:1];
    logic [1:0]  ent_epoch     [0:1];
    logic        ent_issued    [0:1];
    logic        ent_committed [0:1];

    logic        req_active;
    logic        req_we_q;
    logic [31:0] req_addr_q;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_be_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob_q;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch_q;

    logic        tail_valid;
    logic        head_rs1_wake;
    logic        head_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_wake;
    logic        tail_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_ready_eff;
    logic        tail_rs2_ready_eff;
    logic        head_rs1_ok;
    logic        head_rs2_ok;
    logic        head_can_issue;
    logic        head_store_ready;
    logic        head_load_ready;
    logic        head_issue_fire;
    logic        req_accept;
    logic        req_owner_match;
    logic        head_resp_fire;
    logic        head_resp_stale;
    logic        head_load_done;
    logic        head_store_done;
    logic [31:0] head_addr;
    logic [31:0] head_imm;
    logic [3:0]  head_be;
    logic [31:0] head_wdata;
    logic [31:0] load_word;
    logic [31:0] load_data;
    logic [2:0]  head_funct3;
    logic        disp_fire;
    logic        disp_to_head;
    logic        disp_to_tail;
    logic        disp_rs1_eff;
    logic        disp_rs2_eff;
    logic        squash_head;
    logic        squash_tail;
    logic        store_commit_match_head;
    logic        store_commit_match_tail;
    logic        head_remove;
    logic        tail_remove;

    logic        head_rs1_next;
    logic        head_rs2_next;
    logic        tail_rs1_next;
    logic        tail_rs2_next;

    assign head_valid = ent_valid[0];
    assign tail_valid = ent_valid[1];

    assign lsu_prf_rs1_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs1[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs1[1] : 6'd0);
    assign lsu_prf_rs2_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs2[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs2[1] : 6'd0);

    assign head_imm = ent_is_store[0] ?
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:25], ent_insn[0][11:7]} :
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:20]};

    always_comb begin
        head_be    = 4'b0000;
        head_wdata = 32'd0;
        case (head_funct3[1:0])
            2'b00: begin
                head_be    = 4'b0001 << head_addr[1:0];
                head_wdata = {4{lsu_prf_rdata2[7:0]}};
            end
            2'b01: begin
                head_be    = head_addr[1] ? 4'b1100 : 4'b0011;
                head_wdata = {2{lsu_prf_rdata2[15:0]}};
            end

                head_be    = 4'b1111;
                head_wdata = lsu_prf_rdata2;
            end
        endcase
    end

    assign head_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0]));
    assign head_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0]));
    assign tail_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1]));
    assign tail_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1]));

    assign tail_rs1_ready_eff = (ent_prs1[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs1_ready[1] || tail_rs1_wake;
    assign tail_rs2_ready_eff = (ent_prs2[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs2_ready[1] || tail_rs2_wake;

    assign head_rs1_ok = (ent_prs1[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs1_ready[0] || head_rs1_wake;
    assign head_rs2_ok = (ent_prs2[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs2_ready[0] || head_rs2_wake;

    assign head_load_ready  = ent_is_load[0] && head_rs1_ok;
    assign head_store_ready = ent_is_store[0] && ent_committed[0] &&
                              head_rs1_ok && head_rs2_ok;

    assign head_can_issue = head_valid && !ent_issued[0] && !halted && !flush &&
                            !req_active && (head_store_ready || head_load_ready);

    assign req_accept = lsu_dcache_req_valid && lsu_dcache_req_ready;
    assign req_owner_match = ent_valid[0] &&
                             (req_rob_q == ent_rob[0]) &&
                             (req_epoch_q == ent_epoch[0]);
    assign head_issue_fire = req_accept &&
                             (req_active ? req_owner_match : 1'b1);

    assign head_resp_fire = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                            lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                            (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch == ent_epoch[0]) &&
                            !squash_head;
    assign head_resp_stale = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                             lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                             (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch != ent_epoch[0]) &&
                             !squash_head;

    assign load_word = lsu_dcache_resp_rdata;

    always_comb begin
        load_data = load_word;
        case (head_funct3)
            3'b000: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {{24{load_word[7]}},  load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {{24{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {{24{load_word[23]}}, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {{24{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b100: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {24'd0, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b001: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            3'b101: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            default: load_data = load_word;
        endcase
    end

    assign head_load_done  = head_resp_fire && ent_is_load[0];
    assign head_store_done = head_resp_fire && ent_is_store[0];

    assign load_complete_valid     = head_load_done;
    assign load_complete_rob_index = ent_rob[0];
    assign load_complete_prd       = ent_pdst[0];
    assign load_complete_data      = load_data;

    assign store_done_valid     = head_store_done;
    assign store_done_rob_index = ent_rob[0];

    assign store_commit_match_head = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[0] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[0]);
    assign store_commit_match_tail = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[1] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[1]);

    assign squash_head = flush && ent_valid[0] &&
                         !((ent_rob[0] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);
    assign squash_tail = flush && ent_valid[1] &&
                         !((ent_rob[1] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);

    assign head_remove = ent_valid[0] &&
                         (head_load_done || head_store_done || squash_head);
    assign tail_remove = ent_valid[1] && squash_tail;

    assign lsu_dcache_req_valid     = req_active || head_can_issue;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_we        = req_active ? req_we_q : ent_is_store[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_addr      = req_active ? req_addr_q : head_addr;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_wdata     = req_active ? req_wdata_q : head_wdata;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_be        = req_active ? req_be_q : head_be;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_rob_index = req_active ? req_rob_q : ent_rob[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_epoch     = req_active ? req_epoch_q : ent_epoch[0];

    assign lsu_dcache_wait = (req_active || ent_issued[0]) &&
                             !lsu_dcache_resp_valid;

    assign lsu_idle = !ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1] && !req_active;

    assign lsu_disp_ready = rst_n && !halted && !flush &&
                            (!ent_valid[0] || !ent_valid[1]);
    assign disp_fire = lsu_disp_valid && lsu_disp_ready;

    assign disp_to_head = disp_fire &&
                          (!ent_valid[0] ||
                           (head_remove && (!ent_valid[1] || tail_remove)));
    assign disp_to_tail = disp_fire && !disp_to_head &&
                          ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1];

    assign disp_rs1_eff = (lsu_disp_prs1 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs1_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1));
    assign disp_rs2_eff = (lsu_disp_prs2 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs2_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2));

    always_comb begin
        head_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[0];
        head_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[0];
        if (ent_valid[0] && !head_remove) begin
            if (head_rs1_wake) head_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (head_rs2_wake) head_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        tail_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[1];
        tail_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[1];
        if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            if (tail_rs1_wake) tail_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (tail_rs2_wake) tail_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        if (disp_to_head) begin
            head_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            head_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end else if (head_remove && ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            head_rs1_next = tail_rs1_ready_eff;
            head_rs2_next = tail_rs2_ready_eff;
        end

        if (disp_to_tail) begin
            tail_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            tail_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_insn[0]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_insn[1]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_rob[0]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_rob[1]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_prs1[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs1[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_rs1_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs1_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[0]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[1]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[0]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[1]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_epoch[0]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_epoch[1]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[1]  <= 1'b0;
            req_active        <= 1'b0;
            req_we_q          <= 1'b0;
            req_addr_q        <= 32'd0;
            req_wdata_q       <= 32'd0;
            req_be_q          <= 4'd0;
            req_rob_q         <= 4'd0;
            req_epoch_q       <= 2'd0;
        end else begin
            ent_rs1_ready[0] <= head_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[0] <= head_rs2_next;
            ent_rs1_ready[1] <= tail_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[1] <= tail_rs2_next;

            if (store_commit_match_head) ent_committed[0] <= 1'b1;
            if (store_commit_match_tail) ent_committed[1] <= 1'b1;

            if (head_issue_fire) begin
                ent_issued[0]    <= 1'b1;
            end
            if (head_resp_fire || head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_issued[0] <= 1'b0;
            end
            if (head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_epoch[0]  <= flush_epoch;
            end

            if (!req_active) begin
                if (head_can_issue && !lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active  <= 1'b1;
                    req_we_q    <= ent_is_store[0];
                    req_addr_q  <= head_addr;
                    req_wdata_q <= head_wdata;
                    req_be_q    <= head_be;
                    req_rob_q   <= ent_rob[0];
                    req_epoch_q <= ent_epoch[0];
                end
            end else begin
                if (lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active <= 1'b0;
                end
            end

            if (head_remove) begin
                if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                    ent_insn[0]       <= ent_insn[1];
                    ent_rob[0]        <= ent_rob[1];
                    ent_prs1[0]       <= ent_prs1[1];
                    ent_prs2[0]       <= ent_prs2[1];
                    ent_pdst[0]       <= ent_pdst[1];
                    ent_is_load[0]    <= ent_is_load[1];
                    ent_is_store[0]   <= ent_is_store[1];
                    ent_epoch[0]      <= ent_epoch[1];
                    ent_issued[0]     <= ent_issued[1];
                    ent_committed[0]  <= ent_committed[1] |
                                         store_commit_match_tail;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end
            end else if (tail_remove) begin
                ent_valid[1] <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (disp_to_head) begin
                ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[0]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[0]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[0]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[0]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[0]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[0]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[0]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end else if (disp_to_tail) begin
                ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[1]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[1]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[1]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[1]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[1]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[1]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[1]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end
        end
    end

    assign resolve_taken          = resolve_valid && (resolve_actual != (resolve_pc + 32'd4));

  "rtl/execute_alu.sv": "module execute_alu (

    output logic        issue_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  issue_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  issue_pdst,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand1,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_operand2,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_imm,
    input  logic [4:0]  issue_alu_op,
    input  logic [2:0]  issue_wb_sel,
    input  logic        issue_is_branch,
    input  logic        issue_is_jal,
    input  logic        issue_is_jalr,
    input  logic        issue_use_imm,
    input  logic        issue_is_auipc,
    input  logic [31:0] issue_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        issue_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  issue_pred_type,
    output logic        alu_complete_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  alu_complete_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    output logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    output logic        resolve_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  resolve_rob_index,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_pc,
    output logic [31:0] resolve_actual
);

    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_ADD  = 5'd0;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SUB  = 5'd1;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLL  = 5'd2;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLT  = 5'd3;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SLTU = 5'd4;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_XOR  = 5'd5;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRL  = 5'd6;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_SRA  = 5'd7;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_OR   = 5'd8;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AND  = 5'd9;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_PASSB= 5'd10;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BEQ  = 5'd11;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BNE  = 5'd12;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLT  = 5'd13;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGE  = 5'd14;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BLTU = 5'd15;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_BGEU = 5'd16;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JAL  = 5'd17;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_JALR = 5'd18;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_LUI  = 5'd19;
    localparam logic [4:0] ALU_AUIPC= 5'd20;

    localparam logic [2:0] WB_ALU  = 3'b000;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_PC4  = 3'b001;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_LOAD = 3'b010;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_IMM  = 3'b011;
    localparam logic [2:0] WB_AUIPC= 3'b100;

    logic [31:0] op_a;
    logic [31:0] op_b;
    logic [31:0] alu_result;
    logic [31:0] pc_plus4;
    logic [31:0] branch_target;
    logic [31:0] jal_target;
    logic [31:0] jalr_target;
    logic [31:0] ctrl_target;
    logic        branch_taken;
    logic        is_control;
    logic        actual_taken;
    logic [31:0] actual_next_pc;
    logic [31:0] wb_data;
    logic        issue_fire;

    assign op_b = issue_fire ? (issue_use_imm ? issue_imm : issue_operand2) : 32'd0;

        alu_result = 32'd0;
        if (issue_fire) begin

                ALU_SUB:   alu_result = op_a - op_b;
                ALU_SLL:   alu_result = op_a << op_b[4:0];
                ALU_SLT:   alu_result = ($signed(op_a) < $signed(op_b)) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
                ALU_SLTU:  alu_result = (op_a < op_b) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0;
                ALU_XOR:   alu_result = op_a ^ op_b;
                ALU_SRL:   alu_result = op_a >> op_b[4:0];
                ALU_SRA:   alu_result = $signed(op_a) >>> op_b[4:0];
                ALU_OR:    alu_result = op_a | op_b;
                ALU_AND:   alu_result = op_a & op_b;
                ALU_PASSB: alu_result = op_b;
                ALU_LUI:   alu_result = issue_imm;
                ALU_AUIPC: alu_result = issue_pc + issue_imm;
                default:   alu_result = op_a + op_b;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        branch_taken = 1'b0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            case (issue_alu_op)
                ALU_BEQ:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 == issue_operand2);
                ALU_BNE:  branch_taken = (issue_operand1 != issue_operand2);
                ALU_BLT:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) < $signed(issue_operand2));
                ALU_BGE:  branch_taken = ($signed(issue_operand1) >= $signed(issue_operand2));
                ALU_BLTU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 < issue_operand2);
                ALU_BGEU: branch_taken = (issue_operand1 >= issue_operand2);
                default:  branch_taken = 1'b0;
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign pc_plus4      = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + 32'd4) : 32'd0;
    assign branch_target = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + issue_imm) : 32'd0;
    assign jal_target    = issue_fire ? (issue_pc + issue_imm) : 32'd0;
    assign jalr_target   = issue_fire ? ((op_a + issue_imm) & 32'hFFFF_FFFE) : 32'd0;

    always_comb begin
        ctrl_target = pc_plus4;
        if (issue_is_branch) begin
            ctrl_target = branch_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jal) begin
            ctrl_target = jal_target;
        end else if (issue_is_jalr) begin
            ctrl_target = jalr_target;
        end
    end

    assign is_control = issue_is_branch | issue_is_jal | issue_is_jalr;

    always_comb begin
        actual_taken = 1'b0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            if (issue_is_branch) begin
                actual_taken = branch_taken;
            end else if (issue_is_jal || issue_is_jalr) begin
                actual_taken = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign actual_next_pc = actual_taken ? ctrl_target : pc_plus4;

    always_comb begin
        wb_data = 32'd0;
        if (issue_fire) begin
            wb_data = alu_result;
            case (issue_wb_sel)
                WB_ALU:   wb_data = alu_result;
                WB_PC4:   wb_data = pc_plus4;
                WB_LOAD:  wb_data = alu_result;
                WB_IMM:   wb_data = issue_imm;
                WB_AUIPC: wb_data = issue_pc + issue_imm;
                default:  wb_data = alu_result;
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign issue_ready = rst_n & ~halted & ~flush;

    assign alu_complete_valid    = issue_fire;
    assign alu_complete_rob_index= issue_rob_index;
    assign alu_complete_prd      = issue_pdst;
    assign alu_complete_data     = wb_data;

    assign resolve_valid     = issue_fire & is_control;
    assign resolve_rob_index = issue_rob_index;
    assign resolve_pc        = issue_pc;
    assign resolve_actual    = actual_next_pc;

endmodule

    logic [31:0] imm_s;

                wb_sel_c    = WB_LOAD;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_i;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_ADD;

                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_s;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_ADD;

                    3'b001: alu_op_c = ALU_BNE;

                wb_sel_c    = WB_PC4;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;
                imm_sel     = imm_j;
                alu_op_c    = ALU_JAL;
                is_jal_c    = 1'b1;

            7'b1100111: begin
                reg_write_c = 1'b1;
                wb_sel_c    = WB_PC4;
                use_imm_c   = 1'b1;

                alu_op_c    = ALU_JALR;

    assign id_is_ecall    = is_ecall_c;
    assign id_reg_write   = reg_write_c;
    assign id_use_imm     = use_imm_c;
    assign id_is_auipc    = is_auipc_c;
    assign id_pred_next_pc= fetch_pred_next_pc;
    assign id_pred_taken  = fetch_pred_taken;
    assign id_pred_type   = fetch_pred_type;
    assign id_pred_hit    = fetch_pred_hit;

```systemverilog
module physical_register_file (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs1_addr,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs2_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata1,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    input  logic [31:0] load_complete_data
);

    // The rename unit's free list holds 16 physical registers starting at
    // PR 32, and the architectural map covers PR 0..31.  Therefore the
    // maximum physical register ever written is PR 47.  PR 0 is the
    // hardwired architectural zero and is not stored.
    logic [31:0] prf [1:47];

    logic [31:0] iq_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] iq_rdata2_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata1_r;
    logic [31:0] lsu_rdata2_r;

    integer i;

    function automatic logic [31:0] prf_read(input logic [5:0] addr);
        if (addr == 6'd0 || addr >= 6'd48) begin
            prf_read = 32'h0000_0000;
        end else begin
            prf_read = prf[addr];
        end
    endfunction

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (i = 1; i < 48; i = i + 1) begin
                prf[i] <= 32'h0000_0000;
            end
        end else begin
            if (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) && (alu_complete_prd < 6'd48)) begin
                prf[alu_complete_prd] <= alu_complete_data;
            end
            if (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) && (load_complete_prd < 6'd48)) begin
                prf[load_complete_prd] <= load_complete_data;
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        iq_rdata1_r = (iq_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf_read(iq_prf_rs1_addr);
        iq_rdata2_r = (iq_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          load_complete_data :
                      (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == iq_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                          alu_complete_data :
                      prf_read(iq_prf_rs2_addr);
        lsu_rdata1_r = (lsu_prf_rs1_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs1_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf_read(lsu_prf_rs1_addr);
        lsu_rdata2_r = (lsu_prf_rs2_addr == 6'd0) ? 32'h0000_0000 :
                       (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           load_complete_data :
                       (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd == lsu_prf_rs2_addr)) ?
                           alu_complete_data :
                       prf_read(lsu_prf_rs2_addr);
    end

    assign iq_prf_rdata1  = iq_rdata1_r;
    assign iq_prf_rdata2  = iq_rdata2_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata1 = lsu_rdata1_r;
    assign lsu_prf_rdata2 = lsu_rdata2_r;

endmodule

    localparam logic [5:0] PR_ZERO = 6'd0;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Rename / checkpoint state
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map;
    logic [95:0]  free_list;
    logic [3:0]   free_head;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail;
    logic [4:0]   free_count;
    logic [63:0]  ready_tbl;

    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd;
    logic [3:0]   cur_tail;

    localparam logic [191:0] SPEC_INIT = {
        6'd31, 6'd30, 6'd29, 6'd28, 6'd27, 6'd26, 6'd25, 6'd24,
        6'd23, 6'd22, 6'd21, 6'd20, 6'd19, 6'd18, 6'd17, 6'd16,
        6'd15, 6'd14, 6'd13, 6'd12, 6'd11, 6'd10, 6'd9,  6'd8,
        6'd7,  6'd6,  6'd5,  6'd4,  6'd3,  6'd2,  6'd1,  6'd0
    };

    localparam logic [95:0] FREE_INIT = {
        6'd47, 6'd46, 6'd45, 6'd44, 6'd43, 6'd42, 6'd41, 6'd40,
        6'd39, 6'd38, 6'd37, 6'd36, 6'd35, 6'd34, 6'd33, 6'd32
    };

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Decode / dispatch.  All combinational behaviour of this module is
    // expressed with continuous assignments and constant-index
    // (generate-time) part selects only.  There is no combinational
    // process in this module, therefore no latch can ever be inferred
    // and every next-state signal is driven on all paths by construction.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [5:0]  rs1_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rs2_prd;
    logic [5:0]  rd_prd;
    logic [5:0]  old_prd;
    logic        rs1_rdy;
    logic        rs2_rdy;
    logic        need_pr;
    logic        free_avail;
    logic        is_ctrl;
    logic        is_mem;
    logic        is_alu;
    logic        do_alloc;
    logic        do_flush;
    logic [3:0]  alloc_slot;
    logic [5:0]  pdst_new;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs1;
    logic [5:0]  spec_rs2;
    logic [5:0]  spec_old;
    logic [5:0]  free_head_data;

    assign spec_rs1       = spec_map[6*id_rs1 +: 6];
    assign spec_rs2       = spec_map[6*id_rs2 +: 6];
    assign spec_old       = spec_map[6*id_rd  +: 6];
    assign free_head_data = free_list[6*free_head +: 6];

    assign rs1_prd = (id_rs1 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs1;
    assign rs2_prd = (id_rs2 == 5'd0) ? PR_ZERO : spec_rs2;

    assign rs1_rdy = (rs1_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs1_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs1_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs1_prd)));
    assign rs2_rdy = (rs2_prd == PR_ZERO) ? 1'b1 :
                     (ready_tbl[rs2_prd] ||
                      (alu_complete_valid  && (alu_complete_prd  == rs2_prd)) ||
                      (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd == rs2_prd)));

    assign need_pr    = id_reg_write && (id_rd != 5'd0);
    assign free_avail = (free_count != 5'd0);
    assign is_ctrl    = id_is_branch || id_is_jal || id_is_jalr;
    assign is_mem     = id_is_load || id_is_store;
    assign is_alu     = !is_mem && !id_is_ecall;

    assign do_alloc = id_valid && !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign id_ready = !halted && !flush && !ecall_pending && rob_alloc_ready &&
                      (!need_pr || free_avail) &&
                      (!is_alu || iq_disp_ready) &&
                      (!is_mem || lsu_disp_ready);
    assign do_flush   = flush && !halted;
    assign alloc_slot = rob_alloc_index;

    assign rd_prd   = need_pr ? free_head_data : PR_ZERO;
    assign old_prd  = need_pr ? spec_old       : PR_ZERO;
    assign pdst_new = need_pr ? rd_prd         : PR_ZERO;

    assign rob_alloc_valid        = do_alloc;
    assign rob_alloc_pc           = id_pc;
    assign rob_alloc_insn         = id_insn;
    assign rob_alloc_pdst         = rd_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_old_prd      = old_prd;
    assign rob_alloc_arch_rd      = id_rd;
    assign rob_alloc_is_control   = is_ctrl;
    assign rob_alloc_is_store     = id_is_store;
    assign rob_alloc_is_ecall     = id_is_ecall;
    assign rob_alloc_reg_write    = need_pr;

    assign iq_disp_valid          = do_alloc && is_alu;
    assign iq_disp_pc             = id_pc;
    assign iq_disp_insn           = id_insn;
    assign iq_disp_rob_index      = rob_alloc_index;
    assign iq_disp_prs1           = rs1_prd;
    assign iq_disp_prs2           = rs2_prd;
    assign iq_disp_pdst           = rd_prd;
    assign iq_disp_rs1_ready      = rs1_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_rs2_ready      = rs2_rdy;
    assign iq_disp_imm            = id_imm;
    assign iq_disp_alu_op         = id_alu_op;
    assign iq_disp_wb_sel         = id_wb_sel;
    assign iq_disp_is_branch      = id_is_branch;
    assign iq_disp_is_jal         = id_is_jal;
    assign iq_disp_is_jalr        = id_is_jalr;
    assign iq_disp_use_imm        = id_use_imm;
    assign iq_disp_is_auipc       = id_is_auipc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_next_pc   = id_pred_next_pc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_taken     = id_pred_taken;
    assign iq_disp_pred_type      = id_pred_type;

    assign lsu_disp_valid         = do_alloc && is_mem;
    assign lsu_disp_pc            = id_pc;
    assign lsu_disp_insn          = id_insn;
    assign lsu_disp_rob_index     = rob_alloc_index;
    assign lsu_disp_prs1          = rs1_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_prs2          = rs2_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_pdst          = rd_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_rs1_ready     = rs1_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_rs2_ready     = rs2_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_imm           = id_imm;
    assign lsu_disp_is_load       = id_is_load;
    assign lsu_disp_is_store      = id_is_store;
    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flush / free-list push helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [3:0]  flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]  flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]  flush_elig;
    logic [23:0] flush_rank;
    logic [31:0] flush_push_pos;
    logic [3:0]  flush_push_count;

    logic [5:0]  alloc_push_data;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_old;

    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, (3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0])} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    // rank[k] = number of eligible slots whose flush distance is smaller
    // than the distance of slot k (constant-index row decode, full drive).
    genvar gk;
    generate
        for (gk = 0; gk < 8; gk = gk + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gk +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && ((3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0])))};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [63:0]  ready_set;
    logic [63:0]  ready_clr;
    logic [7:0]   slot_win;

                       (load_complete_valid ? (64'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 64'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (64'd1 << rd_prd) : 64'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == slot_rd[5*gw +: 5]) && ((3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0]) < (gw[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0]))) );
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       rst_hit;
            logic [5:0] rst_val;

            assign rst_hit =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0])) ||
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]));

            assign rst_val =
                (slot_win[0] && (slot_rd[4:0]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[5:0]   : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[1] && (slot_rd[9:5]   == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[11:6]  : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[2] && (slot_rd[14:10] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[17:12] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[3] && (slot_rd[19:15] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[23:18] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[4] && (slot_rd[24:20] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[29:24] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[5] && (slot_rd[29:25] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[35:30] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[6] && (slot_rd[34:30] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[41:36] : 6'd0) |
                (slot_win[7] && (slot_rd[39:35] == ga[4:0]) ? slot_old[47:42] : 6'd0);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga[4:0])) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && rst_hit)                       ? rst_val :
                                                              spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (flush_push_pos[3:0]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[0  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (flush_push_pos[7:4]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[6  +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (flush_push_pos[11:8]  == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[12 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (flush_push_pos[15:12] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[18 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (flush_push_pos[19:16] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[24 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (flush_push_pos[23:20] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[30 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (flush_push_pos[27:24] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[36 +: 6] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (flush_push_pos[31:28] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst[42 +: 6] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl[3:0]))             ? alloc_push_data :
                                                                                     free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {64{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (halted) begin
        end else begin
            spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
            free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
            free_head  <= free_head_nxt;
            free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
            free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            ready_tbl  <= ready_nxt;
            slot_pdst  <= slot_pdst_nxt;
            slot_old   <= slot_old_nxt;
            slot_rd    <= slot_rd_nxt;

            if (do_flush) begin
                cur_tail <= flush_next4;
            end else if (do_alloc) begin
                cur_tail <= rob_alloc_index + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/dcache.sv": "module dcache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic        cpu_req_we,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_wdata,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_be,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_rdata,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic        mem_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  mem_req_be,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        dcache_mem_wait,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [2:0] ST_IDLE  = 3'd0;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_REFILL= 3'd1;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_WT    = 3'd2;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_RESP  = 3'd3;

    logic [2:0]  state;
    logic [127:0] line_data [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag  [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  req_be;
    logic        req_we;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0] refill_base;
    logic [1:0]  refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_data_next;
    logic [25:0] refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]  refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] wt_addr;
    logic [31:0] wt_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  wt_be;

    logic [31:0] resp_rdata;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch;

    logic [31:0] lookup_addr;
    logic [1:0]  idx;
    logic [25:0] tag;
    logic [1:0]  wsel;
    logic        hit;
    logic [127:0] hit_line;
    logic [31:0] hit_word;
    logic [31:0] be_mask;
    logic [31:0] merged_word;

    assign lookup_addr = (state == ST_IDLE) ? cpu_req_addr : req_addr;
    assign idx  = lookup_addr[5:4];
    assign tag  = lookup_addr[31:6];
    assign wsel = lookup_addr[3:2];
    assign hit  = line_valid[idx] && (line_tag[idx] == tag);
    assign hit_line = line_data[idx];

    always_comb begin
        case (wsel)
            2'd0:    hit_word = hit_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    hit_word = hit_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    hit_word = hit_line[95:64];
            default: hit_word = hit_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign be_mask = {{8{cpu_req_be[3]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[2]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[1]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[0]}}};
    assign merged_word = (hit_word & ~be_mask) | (cpu_req_wdata & be_mask);

    assign cpu_req_ready = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && ((state == ST_REFILL) || (state == ST_WT));
    assign mem_req_we    = (state == ST_WT);
    assign mem_req_addr  = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_addr : (refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00});
    assign mem_req_wdata = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_wdata : 32'b0;
    assign mem_req_be    = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_be : 4'b1111;

    assign dcache_mem_wait = mem_req_valid && !mem_req_ready;
    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_rdata = resp_rdata;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch;

    always_comb begin
        refill_data_next = refill_data;
        if ((state == ST_REFILL) && mem_req_ready) begin
            case (refill_word)
                2'd0: refill_data_next[31:0]   = mem_resp_data;
                2'd1: refill_data_next[63:32]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd2: refill_data_next[95:64]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd3: refill_data_next[127:96] = mem_resp_data;
                default: refill_data_next = refill_data;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : dcache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state       <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid  <= 4'b0;
            req_addr    <= 32'b0;
            req_wdata   <= 32'b0;
            req_be      <= 4'b0;
            req_we      <= 1'b0;
            req_rob     <= 4'b0;
            req_epoch   <= 2'b0;
            refill_base <= 32'b0;
            refill_word <= 2'b0;
            refill_data <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag  <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx  <= 2'b0;
            wt_addr     <= 32'b0;
            wt_wdata    <= 32'b0;
            wt_be       <= 4'b0;
            resp_rdata  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch  <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && cpu_req_ready) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                        req_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                        req_we    <= cpu_req_we;
                        req_rob   <= cpu_req_rob_index;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_req_we) begin
                            if (hit) begin
                                for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                    if (idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                        case (wsel)
                                            2'd0: line_data[r][31:0]    <= merged_word;
                                            2'd1: line_data[r][63:32]   <= merged_word;
                                            2'd2: line_data[r][95:64]   <= merged_word;
                                            default: line_data[r][127:96] <= merged_word;
                                        endcase
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            wt_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                            wt_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                            wt_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                            state    <= ST_WT;
                        end else if (hit) begin
                            resp_rdata <= hit_word;
                            resp_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b0;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_data_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            case (wsel)
                                2'd0:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[31:0];
                                2'd1:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[63:32];
                                2'd2:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[95:64];
                                default: resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[127:96];
                            endcase
                            resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_data <= refill_data_next;
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_WT: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        resp_rdata <= 32'b0;
                        resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                        state      <= ST_RESP;
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

  "rtl/icache.sv": "module icache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_data,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] ST_IDLE   = 2'd0;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_REFILL = 2'd1;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_RESP   = 2'd2;

    logic [1:0]   state;

    logic [127:0] line_data  [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag   [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0]  refill_base;
    logic [1:0]   refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_next;
    logic [25:0]  refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]   refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] resp_data_r;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch_r;

    logic [1:0]  cpu_idx;
    logic [25:0] cpu_tag;
    logic [1:0]  cpu_wsel;
    logic        cpu_hit;
    logic [31:0] cpu_word;
    logic [127:0] cpu_line;

    logic [1:0]  ref_wsel;
    logic [31:0] ref_word;

    assign cpu_idx  = cpu_req_addr[5:4];
    assign cpu_tag  = cpu_req_addr[31:6];
    assign cpu_wsel = cpu_req_addr[3:2];

    always_comb begin
        cpu_line = line_data[cpu_idx];
        cpu_hit  = line_valid[cpu_idx] && (line_tag[cpu_idx] == cpu_tag);
        case (cpu_wsel)
            2'd0:    cpu_word = cpu_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    cpu_word = cpu_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    cpu_word = cpu_line[95:64];
            default: cpu_word = cpu_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign ref_wsel = req_addr[3:2];
    always_comb begin
        case (ref_wsel)
            2'd0:    ref_word = refill_next[31:0];
            2'd1:    ref_word = refill_next[63:32];
            2'd2:    ref_word = refill_next[95:64];
            default: ref_word = refill_next[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    always_comb begin
        refill_next = refill_data;
        case (refill_word)
            2'd0:    refill_next[31:0]    = mem_resp_data;
            2'd1:    refill_next[63:32]   = mem_resp_data;
            2'd2:    refill_next[95:64]   = mem_resp_data;
            default: refill_next[127:96]  = mem_resp_data;
        endcase
    end

    assign cpu_req_ready  = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_data  = resp_data_r;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch_r;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_REFILL);
    assign mem_req_addr  = refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00};

    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : icache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state        <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid   <= 4'b0;
            req_addr     <= 32'b0;
            req_epoch    <= 2'b0;
            refill_base  <= 32'b0;
            refill_word  <= 2'b0;
            refill_data  <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag   <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx   <= 2'b0;
            resp_data_r  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch_r <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && !halted) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_hit) begin
                            resp_data_r  <= cpu_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b00;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready && mem_resp_valid) begin
                        refill_data <= refill_next;
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            resp_data_r  <= ref_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
